fields.title: Enjigiriza Enkulu za A. B. Simpson
fields.subtitle: Ekitabo kya Ochorus ekiyamba okutegeera obulamu bwe n’enjigiriza ye
fields.description: Obulagirizi obumpi era obwesigwa eri omutima gw’obubaka bwa A. B. Simpson — Enjiri ey’Ebitundu Ebina eya Kristo Omulokozi Waffe, Omutukuza, Omuwonya, era Kabaka Ajja, n’omulamwa ogumu oguli wansi wa byonna: si mukisa wabula Oyo Agaba Omukisa, Kristo Yennyini. Essuula kkumi na mukaaga ennyimpi, buli emu ng’ekomekkerezebwa n’ebibuuzo n’essaala, ezaawandiikibwa Ochorus ng’ekitabo ekiwerekera ebitabo bya Simpson yennyini ebitakyaliko bwannannyini, omusomi by’akubirizibwa n’omutima gwonna okugendako ye kennyini.
fields.about_html:
Kino si kitabo kya A. B. Simpson. Kitabo ekimuwerekera — omulimu ogwetongodde ogw’okunnyonnyola n’okusiima, ogwawandiikibwa Ochorus, ogukuŋŋaanya omutima gw’enjigiriza ye mu ssuula kkumi na mukaaga ennyimpi olw’omusomi owa bulijjo.

Simpson yalina omulamwa gumu: Kristo Yennyini. Emabega w’Enjiri ey’Ebitundu Ebina — Kristo Omulokozi Waffe, Omutukuza, Omuwonya, era Kabaka Ajja — waaliwo ekintu kimu kye yazuula era kye yatakoowanga kukubiriza: nti obulamu bw’Ekikristaayo si kunoonya mukisa, oba ekintu ky’owulira, oba ekirabo, wabula kubeera na Muntu. Edda gwali mukisa, bwe yayimba, naye kaakano ye Mukama. Ekitabo kino kigoberera omuguwa ogwo mu bulamu bwe, mu kuyigiriza kwe ku bulamu obw’omunda ennyo, ne mu kutegeera kwe ku kukkiriza, okusaba n’obuminsani, era buli ssuula ekikomekkereza we yandyagadde ekome: mu bibuuzo bitono n’essaala.

Ebiwandiiko bya Simpson yennyini tebikyaliko bwannannyini era bifunibwa bwereere, era buli ssuula wano ebyogerako omusomi asobole okugenda ku nsibuko. Ekitabo kino kiweebwayo okuggulawo oluggi bwokka. Ebyawandiikibwa mu kitabo kino eky’Oluganda bijulizibwa okuva mu Open Luganda Contemporary Bible (ekitabo eky’Olungereza kijuliza Authorised Version eya King James, Bayibuli Simpson gye yabuuliririzangamu), era tekyefuula kudda mu kifo ky’empapula za Simpson yennyini ezitali za kwanguyiriza, ezijjudde Kristo.

fields.title: Ennyanjula
fields.body_html:
Olwo tewaba kwawulamu, Muyonaani na Muyudaaya …wabula Kristo ye byonna, era abeera mu ffe ffenna. ABAKKOLOSAAYI 3:11

Mu basajja abo amannya gaabwe agakwatagana n’ekibiina ky’obulamu obw’omunda ennyo, A. B. Simpson y’oyo asinga okuba nga omusomi tamumanyi, era y’oyo akabonero ke kasinga okusaasaana mu bifo bingi. Yatandikawo ekibiina ky’obuminsani ekiri mu nsi yonna, era kaakano ekirimu abantu obukadde n’obukadde. Yatandikawo essomero lya Bayibuli erisooka mu North America, era enkola gye yayiiya ekoppeddwa ku buli lukalu lwa nsi. Yawandiika ebitabo nga kikumi, n’ennyimba ezisoba mu kikumi. Yabumba, butereevu oba ng’ayita mu balala, enjigiriza ey’ebyeddiini eya bingi ku kusinza n’okwewaayo kw’Abakristaayo ab’enjiri mu kyasa eky’amakumi abiri — A. W. Tozer yali mwana we mu mwoyo, era ye yawandiika ebyafaayo bye. Era Abakristaayo abasinga obungi abaayiga ebyo bye yateekangako essira tebawulirangako linnya lye.

Ebifunze mu bigambo bina

Enjigiriza ya Simpson nnyangu nnyo okufunza okusinga ey’abalala, kubanga ye yennyini yagifunza. Yagiyita Enjiri ey’Ebitundu Ebina (The Fourfold Gospel), era yagibuulira okumala emyaka amakumi ana: Kristo Omulokozi Waffe. Kristo Omutukuza Waffe. Kristo Omuwonya Waffe. Kristo Kabaka Waffe Ajja. Enteekateeka eyo si y’esinga obukulu; ekisinga kye ekyo kye yazimbibwa okukola. Weetegereze nti byonna ebina bitandika n’ekigambo kye kimu. Simpson teyali awaayo njigiriza nnya, wabula Omuntu omu mu nkolagana nnya, era ekyo kye kyali ensonga yonna. Omubuulizi w’enjiri omu eyali amanyiddwa ennyo mu by’okuwonya bwe yamuyita okwewaayo yonna mu kawefube w’okuwonya mu ggwanga lyonna, Simpson yamuddamu nti yalina ennamuziga ennya ku ggaali lye, era nti yali tayinza kulagajjalira ssatu ku zo alyoke yeewe eri emu yokka. Endowooza eyo — ey’okwagala obujjuvu, ey’okukuuma buli kintu mu kigero kyakyo, ey’okugaana okufuula essira lyonna erimu okuba byonna — y’empisa ye esinga omuwendo, era y’efuula okumusoma okw’omugaso mu mulembe ogujjudde obuweereza obuzimbiddwa ku ndowooza emu yokka.

Ye Yennyini, so si kintu

Naye wansi w’ennamuziga ezo ennya waliwo ekintu ekyangu n’okusingawo, era y’ensonga lwaki Simpson ali mu lunyiriri luno. Oluyimba lwe olusinga okujulizibwa lutandika nga lunnyonnyola enkyukakyuka gye yali ayiseemu: nti edda gwali mukisa, naye kaakano ye Mukama; edda yali nneewulira, naye kaakano Kigambo; edda yayagalanga birabo bye, naye kaakano Omugabi yekka. Oluyimba olwo luyitibwa Ye Yennyini (Himself), era omutwe ogwo gwe gukwata enjigiriza ye yonna ey’ebyeddiini. Simpson yali amaze emyaka mingi ng’anoonya ebyo eby’omwoyo by’ayitamu — okwewaayo okw’omunda ennyo, omukisa ogujjuvu okusingawo, amaanyi ge yalabanga mu balala — era yali akizudde nti buli lwe yatuukanga ku kimu, obwereere obupya bwaddirirangawo. Ekyamenya enzirukanya eyo kwe kuzuula nti Kristo tasooka kugaba bintu. Kristo agaba Ye Yennyini, era ebirala byonna biri mu Ye.

Yeebazibwe Katonda era Kitaawe wa Mukama waffe Yesu Kristo, atuwadde mu Kristo buli mukisa gwonna ogw’omwoyo oguva mu ggulu. ABAEFESO 1:3

Ako ke kaguwa akayita mu ssuula zonna kkumi na mukaaga ez’ekitabo kino, era kye kibuuzo ky’osaanidde okwebuuza buli kiseera ng’osoma: nnoonya kintu okuva gy’ali, oba nnoonya Ye?

Engeri ekitabo kino gye kitegekeddwamu

Essuula kkumi na mukaaga ennyimpi zinnyonnyola enjigiriza ye, nga zitandikira ku ssomo eryo ery’omu makkati, ne ziyita mu nnamuziga ennya ez’eggaali, olwo ne ziyingira mu njigiriza ye ku bulamu bwa nze n’obulamu bwa Kristo, ku Mwoyo Omutukuvu, ku kukkiriza n’okusaba, era ku nkomerero ku bintu bibiri ebyamumalako ebiseera n’amaanyi mu kitundu eky’oluvannyuma eky’obulamu bwe: abaavu abeerabirwa abaali ku mulyango gwe, n’amawanga agaali tegannatuukibwako enjiri emitala w’ennyanja. Buli ssuula ekomekkerezebwa n’ebintu eby’okukolerako n’essaala. Simpson yandikikakatidde. Teyalina bugumiikiriza eri amazima agakoma ku kutegeera kwokka, era buli njigiriza yagipimanga ng’atunuulira obanga ereeta obulamu obukyuse n’omukozi atumibwa. Soma essuula emu buli lunaku, oba emu buli wiiki. Yimirira ku bintu eby’okukolerako. Saba essaala, oba ekisinga obulungi, saba eyiyo.

Waliwo ekintu ekirala kimu ekiteekwa okwogerwa okuva ku ntandikwa, era kisinga okwogerwa mu lwatu. Kino si kitabo ekigulumiza omuntu ng’omuzira, era waliwo ebifo Simpson w’ateekwa okusomebwa n’obwegendereza. Enjigiriza ye ku kuwonya okw’obwakatonda ebadde mukisa eri bangi, naye era ekoze obulabe obwa nnamaddala eri abalala. Simpson yennyini, oluvannyuma lw’okuwonyezebwa kwe mu 1881, yalekera ddala obujjanjabi bw’abasawo, era n’ayigiriza abalala okwesiga Kristo yekka ku lw’omubiri. Abamu ku abo abaamugoberera baafa endwadde ezaali zisobola okujjanjabibwa. Abamu baagambibwa, oba ne beesalirawo bokka, nti obulwadde bwabwe obwali bugenda mu maaso bwakakasanga nti okukkiriza kwabwe kwali kubulamu ekintu — obukambwe obwo bubetense abakkiriza ab’amazima okuva olwo. Essuula Kristo Omuwonya Waffe eyanjula kye yayigiriza, ekiri ekya Bayibuli ddala mu kyo, n’awo we kiteekwa okukomebwako. Nkwegayiridde, soma essuula eyo awamu n’okulabula kwayo, so si nga tokufaako. Enjigiriza ye ku kutukuzibwa ng’omutendera ogwokubiri ogw’enkukunala, ogufunibwa olw’okukkiriza oluvannyuma lw’okukyuka, ekkirizibwa Abakristaayo bangi abatya Katonda, era abalala bangi abasoma ebyawandiikibwa bye bimu ne babitegeera mu ngeri ndala bagigaana. Essuula Okutukuzibwa Ddala egyanjula nga bwe yagiyigiriza, era n’eraga mu bwesimbu awali obutakkiriziganya. Era essuubi lye nti enjiri yandisobodde okutwalibwa mu buli ggwanga mu mulembe gwe yennyini, ne kyanguya okudda kwa Mukama, lyalabika nga lyali kkyamu — nga buli ssuubi ery’engeri eyo bwe libadde. Omugugu gwali mutuufu. Enteekateeka y’ebiseera teyali ntuufu. Kale lwaki tumusoma n’akatono? Kubanga ku nsonga enkulu yali mutuufu nnyo ddala, era kubanga yabeeranga mu ebyo bye yayigirizanga, wadde nga kyamusaasaanyiza nnyo. Emirundi ebiri yaleka ebifo by’obubuulizi ebisinga obweyagaza omusajja ow’ebirabo bye bye yali asobola okufuna, n’agenda okukola mu bantu abataali baagalibwa muntu mulala yenna. Yagaba ensimbi ze yali yeetaaga. Yatuma abaminsani bikumi na bikumi mu bifo bingi ku bo gye bataddayo, era yaziika abaana be yennyini. N’olwekyo okubuulirira kw’ekitabo kino kwe kubuulirira kw’Ebyawandiikibwa: mwekenneenyenga ebintu byonna, kale bwe bibanga ebirungi mubinywezenga (1 Basessaloniika 5:21). Pima buli ssuula ng’ogigeraageranya n’Ekigambo kya Katonda. Simpson w’abeera omwesigwa — era ku Kristo okumala byonna, ku Mwoyo abeera munda, ne ku buvunaanyizibwa bw’ekkanisa yonna obw’obuminsani, mwesigwa ddala — kikkirize n’essanyu era okikoleko. W’asukka ku ebyo ebyawandiikibwa, kiteekeko akabonero, kiteeke ku bbali, era tolina ky’ofiirwa.

Ekigambo eky’enkomerero ku musomi ekitabo kino gwe kiteebereza. Simpson yawandiikiranga abantu b’omu North America ku nkomerero y’ekyasa ekya kkumi n’omwenda, mu kibuga ekyali kijjula abagwira abaasengukirangamu, mu kiseera ekibiina ky’obuminsani eky’omulembe omupya we kyali kikuŋŋaanya amaanyi. Kaakano asomebwa mu bifo bye yasabiranga naye n’atabiraba. Ekibiina kye yatandikawo leero kinene nnyo ebweru w’ensi gye yakoleramu okusinga munda mu yo, ekintu ekyandimusanyusizza era ekitandimwewuunyisizza n’akatono. Teyateebereza mbeera yonna ey’enjawulo, kubanga omulamwa gwe tegwali buwangwa, wabula Omuntu. Buli wonna ekitabo kino we kinaggulwawo, era mu lulimi lwonna lwe kinaatwalibwamu, ekibuuzo kye kinyigiriza kijja kuba nga kiri dda eyo nga kirindiridde.

fields.title: Omusajja ow’Ennamuziga Ennya ku Ggaali Lye
fields.body_html:
Nnyinza okukola byonna mu oyo ampa amaanyi. ABAFIRIPI 4:13

Amaka ag’Abasukuuti ab’endagaano. Albert Benjamin Simpson yazaalibwa nga 15 December, 1843, e Bayview ku kizinga Prince Edward Island, okumpi n’olubalama lw’ebuvanjuba lwa Canada. Bazadde be, James ne Janet Simpson, baali Basukoti, Abapresbiteri, era nga bakakali mu ngeri ey’edda ey’abaakola endagaano (covenanters). Kitaawe yali muzimbi w’amaato era musuubuzi, era mukadde mu kkanisa; Ssabbiiti yakuumibwanga awatali kwekkiriranya, era katekisimu yayigibwanga. Ku nkomerero y’emyaka gya 1840 ebyenfuna by’obusuubuzi bw’oku nnyanja byagwa wansi, bizinensi y’amaka n’egwa, ne basenguka okugenda ebugwanjuba e Chatham mu Ontario. Omulenzi yakulira mu maka agaali gakendedde mu by’obugagga, agaaliko obukakali bw’eddiini n’okweraliikirira okungi. Yali mwana atya amangu era eyeegendereza ennyo mu ndowooza ye ey’omunda, era eddiini ye yamufuula munaku. Yakkiriza enjigiriza naye n’atasobola kuzifunamu mirembe, era n’afuba okutuusa omubiri gwe lwe gwagwa. Okwo kwe kwali okugwa okusooka ku kugwa okuwerako okwali kugenda okulabika mu bulamu bwe.

Omulimu omulungi ogusooka. Obuweerero bwajja nga buyita mu kitabo. Mu mwaka gwe ogw’ekkumi n’etaano, mu kiseera eky’okuzuukuka mu Chatham ng’omubuulizi w’enjiri ow’e Ireland eyali azze okukyala abuulira, yasanga ekitabo eky’edda eky’Omupulitaani Walter Marshall, The Gospel Mystery of Sanctification, n’asoma sentensi eyasumulula ekizibu kye: nti omulimu omulungi ogusooka omuntu gw’alikola kwe kukkiriza Mukama Yesu Kristo. Yali amaze ebbanga ng’agezaako okwekolamu okusaanira okujja. Yalaba nti okukkiriza kwe kwali okujja. Teyafuna nneewulira ya maanyi emuyiikako — ku ekyo yali mwesimbu obulamu bwe bwonna — naye n’akakasa nti Kristo yali amukkirizza. Mu January 1861 yawandiika endagaano entongole ng’eyeewaayo eri Katonda, n’agissaako omukono. Yayingira Knox College, Toronto, n’atikkirwa mu 1865.

Ebifo by’obubuulizi bisatu eby’ekitiibwa. Ebyaddirira gwali mulimu ogw’obuwanguzi obutakoma ku ngulu n’obutamatira obusirifu munda. Ku myaka abiri mu gumu yayitibwa mu Knox Presbyterian Church e Hamilton, Ontario, ekimu ku bibiina by’abasinza ebisinga obunene mu Canada. Yawasa Margaret Henry ennaku bbiri oluvannyuma lw’ebigezo bye eby’okutongozebwa ng’omusumba, era ku Ssande eyaddako yali addiddeyo ku kubuulira mu kkanisa ye. Yakola n’amaanyi mangi nnyo, n’ayongerako bammemba nga lusanvu mu myaka munaana.

Emyaka gy’e Hamilton era gyaleeta ennaku eyasooka. Omwana waabwe ow’obulenzi ow’okubiri, Melville Jennings, yafa ng’aweza emyaka esatu. Simpson yawandiika oluvannyuma nti okutuusa olwo yali agendanga eri amaka agafiiriddwa n’okusaasira okwali okw’amazima naye nga tekuliiko kye kukwatako, kubanga yali tamanyi nnaku ku bubwe. Babiri ku baana baabwe mukaaga baaziikibwa nga bakyali bato. Mu December 1873 yasengukira mu Chestnut Street Presbyterian e Louisville, Kentucky, ekkanisa ya Presbyterian eyali esinga ekitiibwa mu kibuga ekyo. Eyo yakubiriza enkuŋŋaana ez’enjiri ezigatta amadiini gonna, era n’azimba ekizimbe ekyangu eky’okusinzizaamu (tabernacle) abakozi abaali batalina ngoye nnungi basobole okujja awatali kukwatibwa nsonyi. Kyagenda bulungi, naye ekibiina kye tekyasanyuka ddala. Mu 1879 yayitibwa mu Thirteenth Street Presbyterian Church mu kibuga New York, n’atuuka n’asanga ekintu ekyali kigenda okulaga obulamu bwe bwonna obwali busigaddeyo: abagwira emitwalo n’emitwalo nga bayiika mu kibuga ekkanisa zaakyo ez’ekitiibwa mwe zaali tezirina kigendererwa kya kubaaniriza.

Embeera bbiri enkulu. Ebintu bibiri bye yayitamu byamukyusa, era byajja nga biwuddiddwamu emyaka musanvu. Ekisooka kyali mu 1874, e Louisville. Ng’akooye nnyo era ng’ategeera nti obuweereza bwe bwatambuliranga ku maanyi ge yennyini, yasoma The Higher Christian Life ekya W. E. Boardman, n’ayingira mu kye yannyonnyola oluvannyuma ng’okukkiriza Kristo ng’okutukuzibwa kwe — si kufuba kuggya wabula okwesigama okuggya. Obuweereza bwe obwa nnamaddala yabubalira okuva olwo. Ekyokubiri kyali mu biseera by’ebbugumu ebya 1881. Yali amaze emyaka ng’alwadde omutima; omusawo mu New York yali amuwadde emyezi esatu. Mu kifo ky’enkuŋŋaana e Old Orchard Beach mu Maine yawulira Dr Charles Cullis ng’ayigiriza ku kuwonya okw’obwakatonda, era obujulizi bwamukwatako nnyo okusinga ensonga ezaaleetebwa. Ku Lwokutaano olweggulo mu August yagenda yekka mu kibira kya payini n’akola obweyamo obw’ebitundu bisatu: nti akkiriza okuyigiriza kwa Bayibuli nti Yesu ye muwonya w’omubiri; nti amutwala awo wennyini ng’obulamu bwe obw’omubiri olw’ebyetaago byonna eby’omubiri gwe okutuusa omulimu gw’obulamu bwe lwe gunaaggwa; era nti amaanyi g’anaaweebwa yandigakozesezza olw’ekitiibwa kya Katonda n’okuweereza abalala. Yava mu kibira ng’akyuse. Olunaku olwaddirira yalinnya olusozi olwa ffuuti enkumi ssatu. Yawangaala emyaka emirala amakumi asatu mu munaana, era n’akola ku sipiidi eyakooyanga abasajja abato ennyo okumusinga.

Okwawukana. Oluvannyuma mu mwaka ogwo yasaba ekibiina kye okukkiriza ekibinja ky’abagwira Abayitaliyaani abaali bakyuse okufuuka bammemba. Baagaana. Mu November 1881 yalekulira — omusaala ogwali gumunywevu, ekifo ky’obubuulizi eky’ekitiibwa, n’ekkanisa mwe yakulira era mwe yatongolezebwa — nga talina kibiina, talina nsimbi zimuyingirira, era ng’alina amaka ag’okulabirira. Yabatizibwa mu kunnyikibwa mu kkanisa y’Ababatisti mu New York ku ntandikwa y’omwaka ogwaddirira. Yatandika okubuulira mu kizimbe (hall) eri abantu batono nnyo. Mu myaka mitono Gospel Tabernacle yali emu ku bibiina ebisinga obujjumbize mu kibuga, era yali ekola ekyo ekitaakolebwanga muntu mulala yenna: emirimu gy’okununula abaabula, emirimu mu baavu, ennyumba y’abaana bamulekwa, amaka abalwadde mwe baasobolanga okusula ne basabirwa, n’okusinza kw’abagwira mu nnimi zaabwe.

Ebitongole ebyazimbibwa okusindika abantu ebweru. Mu 1882 yaggulawo essomero ery’okutendeka abaminsani — essomero lya Bayibuli erisooka mu North America — ng’akkiriza nti abakkiriza aba bulijjo abalina okutendekebwa okw’enkola n’okuyitibwa basobola okutuusibwa mu nnimiro mu myaka ebiri mu kifo ky’emyaka musanvu. Oluvannyuma lyasengukira waggulu ku mugga Hudson e Nyack. Kumpi buli ssomero lya Bayibuli mu nsi lisibuka mu ndowooza eyo. E Old Orchard mu 1887 yatandikawo ebibiina bibiri: Christian Alliance, olw’okuzimba obulamu obw’omwoyo eka, ne Evangelical Missionary Alliance, olw’okutuma abakozi ebweru. Mu 1897 byegatta ne bifuuka The Christian and Missionary Alliance. Teyalowoozangako kutandikawo kkanisa ya njawulo (denomination). Yayagala ekibiina ekitambula munda mu kkanisa ezaaliwo — okussa kimu kw’abantu okuva mu buli nnono nga bagattibwa Enjiri ey’Ebitundu Ebina n’okubuulira ensi yonna enjiri. Kyafuuka kkanisa ya njawulo ne kiba bwe kityo, ekitera okubaawo. Mu kiseera kye kimu yakulembera magazini eyafulumanga buli wiiki okumala kumpi emyaka amakumi ana, yawandiika ebitabo nga kikumi nga mw’otwalidde n’ekitabo ekinnyonnyola Bayibuli yonna, era n’ayiiya ennyimba ezisoba mu kikumi, emirundi mingi ng’awandiika ebigambo ku Lwomukaaga ekibiina kibiyimbe ku Ssande.

Ekibuuzo kya Pentekoote. Oluvannyuma lwa 1906 Okuzuukuka kw’Abapentekoote kwayita mu bibiina ebyali bisinga okuliraana ekikye, era abantu bangi ab’omu Alliance ne bakwatibwamu. Okuddamu kwa Simpson kwali kwa bwenkanya nga bwe yali bulijjo, era tekwamatiza muntu yenna ddala. Yeegombanga okufuna amaanyi g’Omwoyo agasingawo, era mu August 1907 n’addayo mu kibira kya payini kye kimu e Old Orchard okusaba Katonda amubatize mu ngeri ejjuvu okusingawo. Teyayogera mu nnimi, newaakubadde olwo oba oluvannyuma. Yasalawo nti okwogera mu nnimi kirabo kya nnamaddala Katonda ky’agaba nga bw’ayagala, era nti si bukakafu obwetaagisa obw’okujjula Omwoyo — era n’ateekawo enkola eyeeyolekedde mu Alliance okuva olwo: tonoonya, togaana. Omuwendo gwali gwa nnamaddala. Ekibiina kyafiirwa bammemba ku njuyi zombi, eri abo abaayagala ebisingawo n’eri abo abaayagala oluggi luggalwe.

Enkomerero. Emyaka gye egy’enkomerero gyali mizibu. Yanafuwa, n’atandika okwerabira, era n’ayita mu kiseera eky’ekizikiza eky’omwoyo mikwano gye kye baalaba nga kibaluma nnyo okulaba mu musajja eyali ayigirizza abalala bangi nnyo ku buwanguzi. Yava ku bukulembeze mu 1918. Yazirika n’atamanya (coma) nga 28 October, 1919, n’afa olunaku olwaddirira e Nyack, ng’aweza emyaka nsanvu mu etaano. Teyaleka bugagga. Yaleka essomero ery’okutendeka, magazini, ekitabo ky’ennyimba, ekifo ky’okusinza ekijjudde abaavu, n’abaminsani ebikumi ebiwerako abaasaasaana mu nsi yonna mu bifo bye yali tazzenga alaba era bye yasabiranga ng’abiyita amannya.

fields.title: Ye Yennyini
fields.body_html:
Kubanga mu Kristo okutuukiriza kwonna okw’Obwakabaka mwe kulabikira mu mubiri, era mmwe nga muli mu ye, mwatuukirira mu ye. ABAKKOLOSAAYI 2:9–10

Simpson yawandiika oluyimba olukyayimbibwa mu bifo ebyerabira dda eyaluwandiika, era omutwe gwalwo kigambo kimu kyokka: Ye Yennyini (Himself). Ennyiriri zaalwo zigoberera olugendo. Zinnyonnyola omuntu eyanoonyanga omukisa edda naye kaakano anoonya Mukama; eyabeeranga ku nneewulira edda naye kaakano awummulira ku Kigambo; eyayagalanga ebirabo edda naye kaakano ayagala Omugabi yekka; eyasabanga bulijjo edda naye kaakano bulijjo atendereza. Buli lunyiriri lukyuka mu ngeri y’emu — okuva ku kintu Kristo ky’awa okudda ku Kristo Yennyini. Bino bye byafaayo bye ye yennyini. Era kye kisumuluzo ky’ebirala byonna ebiri mu kitabo kino.

Okukooya okw’okunoonya ekintu

Simpson yamala obuweereza bwe obw’olubereberye mu mbeera Abakristaayo bangi abanyiikivu gye banaategeerera amangu ddala. Yali atuuse ku buwanguzi. Yali munywevu mu njigiriza entuufu. Yakola okutuusa omubiri gwe lwe gwagwa — emirundi egisukka mu gumu. Era yali amanyi nti waliwo ekibulamu, n’atandika okukinoonya mu ngeri abantu abeegendereza gye bakikolamu: ng’anoonya ekintu ekirala eky’omwoyo eky’okuyitamu. Okwewaayo okw’omunda ennyo. Omukisa ogujjuvu okusingawo. Amaanyi ge yalabanga mu balala naye n’atagafuna mu ye yennyini. Obuzibu bw’okunoonya kuno buli nti buli lw’otuuka ku kimu, obwereere obupya buddirira. Ofuna omukisa, era mu wiiki ntono weetaaga omulala. Obulamu bwo obw’Ekikristaayo bufuuka olunyiriri lw’entikko z’ensozi nga wakati waazo waliwo ebiwonvu ebigenda byeyongera obuwanvu, era obulamu bwo obw’omwoyo butandika okwesigama ku bbanga eriyiseewo okuva lwe wasembayo okubeera mu lukuŋŋaana olunene. Simpson teyawona mbeera eno ng’afunye ekintu eky’okuyitamu ekisingako obulungi. Yawona bwe yazuula nti yali asaba ekika ky’ekintu ekikyamu ddala.

Kristo tasooka kugaba bintu

Amagezi gano, bwe gamala okwogerwa, galabika nga gangu nnyo okuba nga gaamumalako bingi bwe bityo. Kristo tasinga kugaba mikisa, ng’omugabi bw’agaba ebirabo okuva mu tterekero. Agaba Ye Yennyini, era buli mukisa guli munda mu Ye, so si kuweebwa ku bbali we.

Kyokka ku bw’oyo muli mu Kristo Yesu, eyafuuka amagezi gye tuli okuva eri Katonda, bwe butuukirivu, n’okutukuzibwa, n’okununulibwa. 1 ABAKKOLINSO 1:30

Kisome mpola. Pawulo tagamba nti Kristo atuwa amagezi, obutuukirivu, okutukuzibwa n’okununulibwa. Agamba nti Kristo yafuuka ebyo gye tuli. Tebiri bintu by’atuwa ng’ebyamaguzi; Ye kennyini bw’ali gye tuli. Okuba naye kwe kuba nabyo, era okubinoonya ng’oli wala naye kwe kunoonya ekitangaala awalala awatali njuba.

Ku kujjula kwe ffenna kwe twagabana ekisa ekisukiridde ekisa. YOKAANA 1:16

Enjiri ya Simpson yonna ey’Ebitundu Ebina etudde ku kino. Teyabuulira bulokozi, okutukuzibwa, okuwonya n’okujja omulundi ogwokubiri ng’emitwe ena. Yabuulira Kristo Omulokozi Waffe, Kristo Omutukuza Waffe, Kristo Omuwonya Waffe, Kristo Kabaka Waffe Ajja — enkolagana nnya n’Omuntu omu. Ggyawo Omuntu oyo, osigaze enjigiriza nnya, nga kino kintu kirala era ekyavuwala ennyo.

Ekigezo

Waliwo ekibuuzo enjigiriza ya Simpson ky’ebuuza omukkiriza, era si kyangu. Teebereza nti Katonda takyakuwa kintu kirala kyonna obulamu bwo bwonna. Tewali kusaba kuddibwamu kw’olindirira kaakano. Tewali kuwona mu mbeera ekunyigiriza. Tewali kugasa kulala, tewali kukula kw’oyinza kulaba, tewali ky’oyitamu kya kunyumya. Kristo Yennyini yandibadde akumala?

Ani gwe nnina mu ggulu, wabula ggwe? Era tewali na kimu ku nsi kye neetaaga bwe mba naawe. ZABBULI 73:25

Abasinga obungi ku ffe, bwe tukibuuza mu mazima, tuzuula nti bingi ku ebyo bye tuyita okwagala Katonda kwe kwagala by’atukolera — era nti okwewaayo kwaffe kulinnya ne kukka okusinziira ku by’akoze gye buvuddeko. Okuzuula okwo si nsonga ya kuggwaamu ssuubi. Kwe kutandika kw’enkyukakyuka oluyimba lwa Simpson lw’ennyonnyola. Yegenderezanga okwongerako nti kino tekifuula mikisa butaba na mugaso. Katonda agaba ebirabo ebya nnamaddala era ayagala tubisanyukire. Ensonga eri ku nsengeka. Noonya ekirabo, oyinza okukifuna n’osigala nga oli bwereere; noonya Omugabi, ebirabo ne bijja nga biri wamu naye, nga obikwata mpola, nga tebikyasobola kukuzimba wadde okukumenya.

Naye musooke munoonye obwakabaka bwa Katonda n’obutuukirivu bwe, ebyo byonna mulibyongerwako. MATAYO 6:33

Abatalina mirembe kino kibaleka wa

Obuweerero obw’enkola obuli mu njigiriza eno bunene, era y’ensonga lwaki Simpson yali wa mugaso nnyo eri abaali bakooye.

Bw’oba nga ky’oyagala kintu kya kuyitamu, olwo oteekwa okusigala ng’okifuna buli kiseera, era obeera mu kabi bulijjo — okuva ku mpisa zo ez’obuzaale, ku bulamu bwo, ku mbeera zo, ku mutindo gw’olukuŋŋaana lwa Ssande ewedde. Bw’oba nga ky’oyagala Muntu, era Omuntu oyo abeera mu ggwe era yasuubiza obutakuleka, olwo by’ofuna tebikendeera newaakubadde ng’okuwulira kwo okw’ebyo kukyukakyuka.

Kubanga Katonda yagamba nti, “Sirikuleka era sirikwabulira n’akatono.” ABAEBBULANIYA 13:5

Simpson yayigiriza abakkiriza okulekera awo okusaba Omwoyo Omutukuvu omungi okusingawo, batandike okutegeera Omwoyo Omutukuvu bw’abalinako ennyo. Obuzibu tebwali mu bungi bw’ebiweebwa.

Waliwo engeri ey’okugezesa obanga kino kivudde ku ndowooza ne kituuka mu bikolwa, era kitwala nga wiiki emu okukikola. Wuliriza okusaba kwo. Bala obungi bwakwo obusaba Kristo ekintu, n’obungi obumwagala Ye yekka. Abasinga obungi ku ffe tusanga olukalala olw’okubiri kumpi nga lwereere, so nga olukalala olusooka tubadde tuluyita obulamu obw’okusinza.

Okukogga kw’emmeeme

Waliwo olunyiriri mu Zabbuli olunnyonnyola akabi k’okufuna ekyo ky’osabye, era Simpson yaluddangamu emirundi mingi.

Bw’atyo n’abawa kye baasaba, kyokka n’abaleetera n’olumbe olw’amaanyi. ZABBULI 106:15

Isirayiri mu ddungu baayagala ennyama. Beemulugunya okutuusa lwe baagifuna. Katonda yabawa kye baasaba nga bwe baakisaba ddala, era waliwo ekyabula mu kuweebwa okwo kye baali tebalowoozezza kukuuma. Okulabula si kwe kuba nti Katonda atubonereza olw’okusaba. Kwe kuba nti okusaba okuddibwamu ku bukwakkulizo bwaffe kuyinza okutuleka nga tukozze okusinga bwe twali, kubanga kye twali twetaaga ddala tekyali kintu ekyo, wabula Katonda eyali akituziyiza, era twali tuli mu kwegayirira n’okuteesa ne tutakiraba. Simpson kino yakikozesa butereevu ku kunoonya ebintu eby’omwoyo eby’okuyitamu. Omukkiriza ayinza okuteeka omutima gwe ku mukisa ogumu — okufuna amaanyi, okuwonyezebwa, obuweereza, okugonjoolwa kw’ekizibu ekimaze ebbanga — n’aginoonya n’obunyiikivu obwa nnamaddala, n’agufuna, n’asanga nga tali kumpi ne Katonda okusinga bwe yali. Waliwo okukogga okuyinza okubeerawo awamu n’okusaba okuddibwamu. Eddagala si kulekera awo kusaba. Kwe kwagala Omugabi okusinga ekirabo, olwo okuddibwamu bwe kunajja, kujje mu bulamu obumaze okussa ekifo kyabwo eky’omu makkati awalala.

Sanyukiranga mu Mukama, anaakuwanga omutima gwo bye gwetaaga. ZABBULI 37:4

Olunyiriri olwo lutera okusomebwa ng’ekisuubizo nti Katonda ajja kutuwa buli kye twagala bwe tunaaba nga tumusinza ekimala. Simpson yalusoma mu ngeri ey’okukyusa, era ensengeka y’ebigambo emuwagira: okusanyuka kusooka, era mu kusanyukira Mukama, ebyo bye twegomba byennyini mwe bikyusibwa ne bifuuka ebintu by’asanyukira okugaba.

OKUFUMIITIRIZA N’OKUKOLA

1. Buuza ekibuuzo ekizibu butereevu: Katonda bw’aba takyakuwa kintu kirala, Kristo Yennyini yandibadde akumala? Mugambe okuddamu kwo okw’amazima so si okuddamu okutuufu.

2. Kebera okusaba kwo okwa wiiki emu. Kitundu ki ekyanoonya ekirabo, era kitundu ki ekyanoonya Omugabi?

3. Londa omukisa gumu gw’obadde onoonya ng’olinga asobola okuguwula ku Kristo. Noonya Ye, ogulekere gujje ng’ekitundu ku Ye.

4. Weetegereze obanga embeera yo ey’omwoyo yeesigamye ku bbanga eriyiseewo okuva lwe wasembayo okuyita mu kintu eky’amaanyi eky’omwoyo. Bw’eba bwe kityo, eyo y’enkola Simpson gye yawonamu.

5. Wiiki eno mala eddakiika kkumi na ttaano nga tolina ky’osaba Katonda n’akatono, ng’omussaako omwoyo gwokka.

ESSAALA
Mukama Yesu, nnyagadde emikisa gyo okusinga bwe nkwagadde Ggwe, era ekyo nkiyise okusinza.
Nnoonyezza ebintu eby’okuyitamu ne nsigala nga ndi bwereere oluvannyuma lwa wiiki bbiri. Obulamu bwange obw’omwoyo mbupimidde ku ngeri gye nnawuliramu ku Ssande. Nsonyiwa.
Ggwe wafuuka amagezi gye ndi, obutuukirivu, okutukuzibwa n’okununulibwa. Seetaaga kugabirwa bintu bino. Nkwetaaga Ggwe, era nkulina.
Beera omugabo gwange. Ka njagale Omugabi, ebirabo bigwe we biyagala. Amiina.

fields.title: Kristo Omulokozi Waffe
fields.body_html:
Tewali mu mulala yenna bulokozi, era tewali linnya ddala na limu mu mannya gonna agaaweebwa abantu, wansi w’eggulu, mwetugwanira okulokolebwa. EBIKOLWA BY’ABATUME 4:12

Ennamuziga esooka ey’eggaali y’eyo buli Mukristaayo gy’alowooza nti yamala dda okugitegeera, era engeri Simpson gy’agikwatamu esaanidde okussibwako omwoyo olw’engeri gye yagituukako.

Omulenzi eyali tasobola kuyingira

Yakulira mu maka ag’Abapresbiteri ab’e Scotland agaali amakakali, n’ayigirizibwa katekisimu mu bujjuvu, era ekyo ne kimufuula munaku mu bujjuvu. Yakkiriza buli njigiriza gye yali ayigiriziddwa. Teyasobola kufuna mirembe mu yonna ku zo. Obuzibu tebwali bwa magezi. Bwali nti yalowooza nti asaanidde okusooka okutuuka ku mbeera emu — okwenenya okumala, ennaku emala, okwewaayo okw’omutindo ogumu — nga tannaba kujja eri Kristo. Era buli lwe yeekeberanga, yasanganga ng’embeera eyo tannagituukako. Yeewaliriza okutuusa omubiri gwe lwe gwagwa ng’agezaako okugituukako. Ekyamusumulula, ku myaka kkumi n’etaano, yali sentensi mu kitabo eky’edda eky’Omupulitaani: nti omulimu omulungi ogusooka omuntu gw’alikola kwe kukkiriza Mukama Yesu Kristo. N’akiraba. Yali amaze ebbanga ng’agezaako okufuuka asaanidde okujja, so nga okujja kwe kwali okusaanira. Tewaaliwo kya kuleeta.

Katonda tayinza kukusembeza olw’ebikolwa byo. Katonda asembeza aboonoonyi olw’okukkiriza kwe balina mu ye. ABARUUMI 4:5

Obulamu bwe bwonna yali mwesimbu nti tewaaliwo nneewulira ya maanyi eyagenda n’ekyo. Yatwala butwazi ekyo ekyaweebwa, oluvannyuma n’akakasa nti Kristo yali amukkirizza. Enneewulira zajja oluvannyuma, nga tezirina nteekateeka, era teyazikkiriza kufuuka musingi.

Okusinga okusonyiyibwa

Naye essira lya Simpson ery’enjawulo liri walala, era libumba buli kimu ekiddirira mu njigiriza ye. Obulokozi, nga bwe yabubuuliranga, si kusazaamu bbanja kwokka. Kwe kuteekebwa mu muntu obulamu.

Buli alina Omwana alina obulamu, naye oyo atalina Mwana wa Katonda talina bulamu. 1 YOKAANA 5:12

Omuntu ayinza okusonyiyibwa n’asigala nga bwe yali. Singa obulokozi bwali kusonyiyibwa kwokka, omwonoonyi yandivudde mu kkooti ng’asumuluddwa naye nga takyuse, ng’atunuulidde ebiseera eby’omu maaso bye bimu n’obutonde bwe bumu. Ebyawandiikibwa kye binnyonnyola kwe kuzaalibwa — engeri empya ey’okubeerawo, nga mu yo mulimu obulamu obutaaliyo luberyeberye.

Noolwekyo omuntu yenna bw’abeera mu Kristo, aba kitonde kiggya; eby’edda nga bigenze, laba ng’afuuse muggya. 2 ABAKKOLINSO 5:17

Eno y’ensonga lwaki Simpson yasobolanga okuva ku nnamuziga esooka n’atuuka ku y’okubiri mu ngeri ennyangu bw’etyo. Obulokozi bwe bubeera okuteekebwa mu muntu obulamu bwa Kristo, olwo okutukuzibwa si nteekateeka yeetongodde eyeetaaga ebyuma ebirala. Bwe bulamu bwe bumu, nga bufunibwa n’okusingawo.

Kristo bwe bulokozi bwaffe, so si ye eyabutandikawo kyokka

Weetegereze nate ensengeka y’ebigambo by’Enjiri ey’Ebitundu Ebina. Si Kristo omugabi w’obulokozi, wabula Kristo Omulokozi Waffe — era ne kino Simpson yakinyigiriza okutuusa lwe kyafuuka eky’obwannannyini.

Mukama ge maanyi gange era lwe luyimba lwange, era afuuse obulokozi bwange. OKUVA 15:2

Afuuse obulokozi bwange. Si nti abuteeseteese. Endagaano Enkadde ekyogera emirundi mingi, era Simpson teyakkiriza kigambo ekyo kufuulibwa lugero bugero. Kristo tayimirira bweru waffe ng’akutte obulokozi bwaffe; ayingira, era Ye bwe bulokozi obwo. Enjawulo ey’enkola eyoleka omukkiriza bw’ayonoona. Obulokozi bwe buba kintu kye waweebwa, okulemererwa kuleeta ekibuuzo obanga okyabulina, era omuntu ow’omutima ogweraliikirira amala obulamu bwe ng’akebera. Obulokozi bwe buba Muntu eyakkiriza okubeera omwo, ekibuuzo kikyuka ddala: si nti nkyabulina? wabula nti akyaliwo? — era ekyo Ye Yennyini yakiddamu.

Nziwa obulamu obutaggwaawo, era tezigenda kuzikirira. Tewali n’omu ayinza kuzisikula mu mikono gyange. YOKAANA 10:28

Bwa bwereere, n’olwekyo tebulindirira

Ekigambo ekirala kimu, kubanga kinnyonnyola obulamu bwa Simpson obwasigalawo. Obulokozi okuba obwa bwereere tekyamufuula wa kugayaala ku nsonga eyo. Kyamufuula ow’omutima oguyaayaana. Omuntu akkiriza nti obulokozi bulina okukolerwa ayinza okusalawo mu magezi nti abantu abasinga obungi tebajja kubufuna, n’akkiriza bukkiriza. Omuntu akkiriza nti bwa bwereere, bujjuvu, era nti buli muntu yenna ayinza okubutwala butwazi, tasobola kuteeka mutima wansi ng’amanyi nti obukadde n’obukadde tebabuulirwangako. Okwagala kwa Simpson okw’obuminsani tekwali bujjumbize bweyawudde obwakomererwa ku njigiriza ye. Kwali kiva butereevu mu ebyo bye yakkiriza ku kisa.

Kale balikoowoola batya oyo gwe batakkiririzaamu? Era balikkiriza batya oyo gwe batawulirangako? Era baliwulira batya awatali abuulira? ABARUUMI 10:14

Bw’oba ng’obadde n’okubuusabuusa okusirifu nti oteekwa okutuuka ku mutindo ogumu Katonda alyoke akukkirize mu bujjuvu, sentensi eyasumulula omulenzi omunaku ow’emyaka kkumi n’etaano mu Ontario esaanidde okugimalako ekiseera. Omulimu omulungi ogusooka gw’olikola kwe kukkiriza Mukama Yesu Kristo. Ebirala byonna biddirira. Tewali kirala kisooka.

Obukakafu obutesigama ku nneewulira

Okukyuka kwa Simpson yennyini kuwa essomo ery’omugaso ku buzibu obutera ennyo okubaawo. Yatwala Kristo ku myaka kkumi n’etaano n’atawulira kintu. Okumala ekiseera oluvannyuma, yeeraliikiriranga olw’okubulawo okwo, kubanga yali awulidde abalala nga banyumya essanyu eryabajjula bwe baakyuka, so nga ye yali talina kye yandinyumizza kifaanana bwe kityo. Ku nkomerero yasalawo nti yali anoonya obukakafu mu kifo ekikyamu. Endagaano Empya tesimba bukakafu ku mutindo gw’ekyo omuntu ky’ayiseemu, wabula ku bwesigwa bw’ekigambo.

Ebyo mbiwandiikidde mmwe abakkiriza erinnya ly’Omwana wa Katonda, mulyoke mumanye nti mulina obulamu obutaggwaawo. 1 YOKAANA 5:13

Yokaana agamba nti yawandiika abakkiriza balyoke bamanye — era ekyo kye bamanyiramu kye kyawandiikibwa, so si nneewulira ewuliddwa. N’olwekyo okubuulirira kwa Simpson eri abeeraliikirivu kwali kwangu era nga si kwa kwewoomya. Tokebera nneewulira zo okuzuula obanga wali olokose; kebera Katonda ky’asuubizza abo abajja gy’ali, olwo osalewo obanga ggwe wajja.

Buli muntu Kitange gw’ampa alijja gye ndi, era buli ajja gye ndi sirimugobera bweru. YOKAANA 6:37

Yeetegereza nti ekisuubizo ekyo, mu Bayibuli gye yasomanga, kyakozesa okugaana okw’emirundi ebiri — in no wise, kwe kugamba n’akatono ddala — era yakitwala ng’ekigenderere. Kirabika Mukama yali amanyidde ddala omuntu oyo eyandijja n’oluvannyuma n’abuusabuusa obanga yakkirizibwa. Bino byonna tebifuula nneewulira butaba na mugaso. Simpson yalina nneewulira nnyingi oluvannyuma, era n’azivaamu ennyimba. Ensonga eri ku musingi: enneewulira esanyusa nnyo okusinga ekituufu naye nga tesobola kwesigwa nnyo nga kyo, era ennyumba ezimbiddwa ku yo ejja kunyeenyeka buli nnannyini yo lw’akoowa, lw’alwala oba lw’aggwaamu amaanyi.

OKUFUMIITIRIZA N’OKUKOLA

1. Yogera embeera gy’obadde ogezaako okutuukako mu kasirise nga tonnakkiriza nti Katonda akukkiriza mu bujjuvu. Olwo lekera awo okugezaako okugituukako.

2. Kebera obanga obukakafu bwo butudde ku nneewulira oba ku ebyo Katonda by’ayogedde. Bwe buba ku nneewulira, kyusa obuzito mu bugenderevu.

3. Lowooza obanga otwala obulokozi ng’endagaano gye wafuna oba ng’Omuntu abeera mu ggwe. Eky’okubiri kikyusa engeri gy’okwatamu okulemererwa.

4. Bw’oba tonnatwala Kristo mu ngeri etegeerekeka, mutwale kaakano, mu bigambo ebyangu ennyo by’osobola. Tewali kya kuleeta.

5. Leka obwereere bw’enjiri buleete obwangu so si obugayaavu. Yogera erinnya ly’omuntu omu atawulirangako njiri mu lwatu.

ESSAALA
Mukama Yesu, mmaze emyaka mingi nga ngezaako okufuuka asaanidde okujja gy’oli, so nga okujja kwe kwali okusaanira ebbanga lyonna.
Sirina kye ndeeta. Sirina kya kuleeta. Ntwala ky’ompadde kubanga okimpadde, so si kubanga nsaanidde.
Beera obulokozi bwange — si kirabo ekikwatiddwa ewala, wabula Ggwe Yennyini ng’obeera mu nze.
Era bwe mba nga nfunye buwa, ka nneme kuba mukkakkamu ku abo abatabuulirwangako. Amiina.

fields.title: Kristo Omutukuza Waffe
fields.body_html:
Katonda ow’emirembe abatukulize ddala …Oyo eyabayita mwesigwa era alikituukiriza. 1 BASESSALONIIKA 5:23–24

Mu 1874, e Louisville, Simpson yali musumba w’ekkanisa ya Presbyterian esinga obukulu mu kibuga, naye mu kyama ng’amaanyi ge gamuweddeko. Yali akola ku mbiro ezaali zigenda okumumenyaamenya, era yali akimanyi nti omulimu gwali gutambulira ku maanyi ge ye yekka. Yali mu njigiriza entuufu, ng’asiimibwa, naye ng’akalidde mu mwoyo. Bwe yali asoma ekitabo kya W. E. Boardman The Higher Christian Life, yatuuka ku kye yayita oluvannyuma okufuna Kristo ng’okutukuzibwa kwe — era entandikwa entuufu ey’obuweereza bwe yagibalira ku kiseera ekyo.

Si kwetuukako wabula kufuna

Omutima gw’enjigiriza ya Simpson wano gusangibwa mu kigambo kimu ekitono. Abakkiriza abasinga obungi batwala obutukuvu ng’ekintu eky’okutuukako olw’amaanyi gaabwe. Tuzuula ebisobyo byaffe, ne tumalirira, ne tufuba, ne twekebera nga bwe tweyongerayo, era ne tulemererwa buli kiseera mu ngeri ekooya. Okutukuzibwa kufuuka pulojekiti ey’okwerongoosa eyambaziddwa olulimi lw’eddiini, era ebibala byakwo ebya bulijjo kwe kukoowa n’okwefuula. Simpson yayigiriza nti obutukuvu bwa kufunibwa, kubanga si mpisa buwa wabula Muntu.

Kyokka ku bw’oyo muli mu Kristo Yesu, eyafuuka amagezi gye tuli okuva eri Katonda, bwe butuukirivu, n’okutukuzibwa, n’okununulibwa. 1 ABAKKOLINSO 1:30

Kristo kwe kutukuzibwa kwaffe mu ngeri y’emu ddala nga bw’ali obutuukirivu bwaffe. Obutuukirivu tetwabwekolera, n’okutukuzibwa tetujja kukwekolera. Kristo y’omu gwe twafuna olw’okusonyiyibwa gwe tufuna olw’obutukuvu, mu kukkiriza kwe kumu, ku bukwakkulizo bwe bumu.

Nga bwe mwaweebwa Kristo Yesu Mukama waffe, mutambulirenga mu ye. ABAKKOLOSAAYI 2:6

Nga bwe mwaweebwa — kwe kugamba, olw’okukkiriza, buwa, ng’ekirabo. Mutambulirenga — mu ngeri y’emu, okutuukira ddala ku nkomerero.

Ettabi n’omuzabbibu

Ekifaananyi Simpson kye yeesigamangako okusinga, nga bwe kiri eri abasinga obungi ku bayigiriza b’obulamu obw’omunda ennyo, gwe muzabbibu.

Mubeere mu Nze era nange mbeere mu mmwe. Ng’ettabi bwe litayinza kubala bibala ku bwalyo nga teriri ku muzabbibu, bwe mutyo nammwe temuyinza kubala bibala bwe mutabeera mu Nze. YOKAANA 15:4

Yalaga nti ettabi teribala bibala lwa kufuba. Libala ebibala — awatali kufuba kwalyo — kubanga amazzi g’omuti agava awalala gakulukutira mu lyo. Obuvunaanyizibwa bw’ettabi bwonna kwe kusigala nga lyegasse ku muzabbibu. Kino si kuyita muntu kugayaala, era enteekateeka y’emirimu gya Simpson yennyini ewakanya okutegeera kwonna okw’engeri eyo. Yakola nnyo okusinga kumpi buli muntu mu mulembe gwe. Ekibuuzo si kya kuba nti Omukristaayo ategana oba tategana, wabula kya maanyi ga ani okutegana okwo kwe kutambulirako.

Kyenva ntegana nga nfuba nga nkozesa obuyinza Katonda bw’ampa obw’amaanyi. ABAKKOLOSAAYI 1:29

Pawulo ategana; afuba; era akikola ng’akozesa amaanyi agatali ge. Simpson yatwala olunyiriri olwo nga lwe lunnyonnyola ddala obulamu obutukuziddwa.

Akaseera ak’enkyukakyuka n’olugendo lw’okukula

Wano tutuuka ku kitundu ky’enjigiriza ye ekiwakanyizibwa, era kisaana okunnyonnyolwa mu lwatu. Simpson yali akkiriza nti okutukuzibwa kuzingiramu akaseera ak’enkyukakyuka akategeerekeka — akaseera omukkiriza, ng’amaze okulaba obutamala bwe, mw’awaayo mu bugenderevu obulamu bwe bwonna n’afuna Kristo olw’okukkiriza ng’obutukuvu bwe. Kino teyakitwala ng’eky’okwesalirawo, wadde ng’eky’okwongerako eri Abakristaayo abaakula ennyo mu mwoyo. Yalowooza nti abakkiriza abasinga obungi baali babeera wansi nnyo w’ebirungi bye baweebwa, kubanga baali tebakolangako kikolwa ekyo eky’okwewaayo. Era yali ategeeza bulungi nti akaseera ako ak’enkyukakyuka si ye nkomerero. Ekiddirira bulamu bwonna obw’okukula, nga okwewaayo okwakolebwa omulundi gumu kuteekwa okukuumibwa buli lunaku n’okutuusibwa ku bitundu ebitannaba kwekenneenyezebwa.

Mweyongere okukula mu kisa ne mu kutegeera Mukama waffe era Omulokozi waffe Yesu Kristo. 2 PEETERO 3:18

Kaakano ekyo kye tuteekwa okugattako mu bwesimbu. Abakristaayo bangi abeegendereza basoma Endagaano Empya mu ngeri ya njawulo. Bakkiriza nti okutukuzibwa kutandika ku kukyuka era ne kugenda mpolampola mu bulamu bwonna, nti Ebyawandiikibwa tebiyigiriza wonna kaseera ka nkyukakyuka ak’okubiri ak’enjawulo, era nti enteekateeka ya Simpson eyinza okuleka abakkiriza nga beesigama ku kye baayitamu edda, oba nga baggwaamu essuubi kubanga tebasobola kuzuula kaseera ng’ako. Ennono ya Reformed, Simpson yennyini mwe yakulira, okutwalira awamu ekkiriza bwe kityo. Omusomi yeewulire nga wa ddembe okukipima. Ekitali kya kuwakanyizibwako — era ye nsonga enkulu ey’essuula eno — kiri nti obutukuvu mulimu gwa Kristo mu ffe so si kye twetuukako, nti bufunibwa olw’okukkiriza so si kukolebwa lwa kumalirira, era nti abakkiriza bangi nnyo tebeewaayo ddala n’akatono mu ngeri etegeerekeka.

Temuwangayo bitundu byammwe eby’omubiri okukozesebwa ebitali bya butuukirivu eri ekibi, naye mweweereyo ddala eri Katonda. ABARUUMI 6:13

Oba okwewaayo okwo kaseera ka nkyukakyuka, oba kwe kusooka mu kwewaayo okutono omutwalo, kuteekwa okubaawo.

Mu kino mulimu engeri y’okwekebera buli muntu gy’ayinza okukozesa. Twala ekisobyo ky’omaze ebbanga eddene okusinga ng’olwana nakyo — obusungu, olulimi, okwegomba, okutya. Weebuuze mu bwesimbu engeri gy’obadde okozesa. Bw’oba ng’eky’okuddamu kwe kumalirira, okwekeberanga n’okufuba, obadde ogezaako okukola ekyo Kristo yekka ky’ayinza okuba mu ggwe. Kino si nsonga ya kuleka kukola kintu kyonna. Nsonga ya kukola kintu kya njawulo.

Kye kitategeeza

Simpson yeegendereza okwetooloola enjigiriza eno n’olukomera, kubanga olulimi lw’enjigiriza y’obutukuvu lukozeseddwa okwewaana ebintu Ebyawandiikibwa bye bitayogera. Tekitegeeza kutuukirira okutaliiko kibi. Simpson yawakanya nti waliwo omukkiriza yenna atuuka ku mbeera ekibi mw’ekitasobola kubaawo, oba okukemebwa mwe kutaba na maanyi. Yali akkiriza nti obusobozi bw’okukola ekibi busigalawo, nti omukkiriza ayimirira lwa kweyongera kwesigama ku Kristo kyokka, era nti buli agamba ekirala aba awakanya omutume.

Bwe twogera nti tetulina kibi, twerimba ffekka, era n’amazima tegaba mu ffe. 1 YOKAANA 1:8

Tekitegeeza kusiguukululwa kwa butonde obukadde. Simpson kye yayigiriza kyali kusindiikirizibwa mu kifo, so si kuggibwawo — Kristo abeera munda ng’atwala era ng’afuga ekyo ekisigaddewo, buli kaseera, nga omugga bwe gukuuma omukutu nga mulongoofu olw’okweyongera okukulukuta, so si lwa mukutu kukyusibwa. Era tekitegeeza nkomerero ya kukula. Omukkiriza eyeewaddeyo mu ngeri esinga obujjuvu gy’amanyi okwewaayo, awaddeyo ekyo kyokka kye yali asobola okulaba mu kiseera ekyo. Oluvannyuma lw’emyaka kkumi Katonda ajja kumulaga ebitundu bye yali tamanyi nti biriwo, era okwewaayo kwe kumu kujja kwetaagisa nate ku ttaka eppya.

Ekkubo ly’abatuukirivu liri ng’enjuba eyakavaayo, eyeeyongera okwaka okutuusa obudde lwe butangaalira ddala. ENGERO 4:18

Ekifaananyi kya kutangaala okweyongera, so si kya kutuuka. Simpson yakikozesa okukuuma abakkiriza obutagwa mu nsobi bbiri omulundi gumu: okwekakasa okw’amalala okugamba nti ensonga ewedde era teyetaaga kufiibwako nate, n’okuggwaamu essuubi okugamba nti tewali kyabaddewo kubanga byonna tebinnabaawo.

OKUFUMIITIRIZA N’OKUKOLA

1. Londa ekibi ky’omaze ebbanga eddene okusinga ng’olwana nakyo n’amaanyi g’okumalirira kwo. Kireete eri Kristo ng’ensonga mw’ojja okufunira obuwanguzi ng’ekirabo, so si mw’ojja okubwetuusaako.

2. Kola ekikolwa ekitegeerekeka eky’okwewaayo bw’oba tonnakikolangako: weewaayo, mu bigambo, ku lunaku olumanyiddwa, era obuulireko omuntu.

3. Kebera amaanyi ga ani obuweereza bwo kwe butambulira. Obukoowu n’okunyiiga bitera okuba obubonero obusooka obw’eky’okuddamu ekikyamu.

4. Yiga okubeera mu Kristo mu ngeri ey’ebikolwa: ekiseera ekigere buli lunaku eky’okwesigama ku ye mu bugenderevu nga tonnatandika mirimu gya lunaku, so si ng’omaze.

5. Kwata enjigiriza eno n’obukkakkamu. Abakkiriza ab’amazima bayawukana ku kaseera ak’enkyukakyuka; tewali n’omu ayawukana ku bwetaavu bw’obutukuvu.

ESSAALA
Mukama Yesu, mbadde ngezaako okukola obutukuvu Ggwe wekka bw’oyinza okuba mu nze.
Nnamalirira ne nnemererwa, nnamalirira ne nnemererwa, era enzirukanya eyo ne ngiyita obulamu bw’Ekikristaayo. Nkooye, era ndowooza nti ekyo kwe kusaasira kwo.
Nneewaayo — si kitundu, era si ku bukwakkulizo. Beera okutukuzibwa kwange mu mazima nga bw’oli obutuukirivu bwange.
Nkuuma nga mbeera mu Ggwe. Ebibala bibe bibyo, era ndeke okwemaanyiza okukuza ekyo amazzi g’omuti gokka ge gayinza okuleeta. Amiina.

fields.title: Kristo Omuwonya Waffe
fields.body_html:
Waliwo omulwadde mu mmwe? Kirungi atumye abakulembeze b’Ekkanisa, bamusabire, era bamusiige amafuta, nga bwe basaba Mukama amuwonye. YAKOBO 5:14

Eno ye nnamuziga esinga okuwakanyizibwa ku ggaali lya Simpson, era eteekwa okukwatibwa n’obwegendereza okusinga essuula endala yonna mu kitabo kino. Nkwegayiridde, soma okulabula okuli ku nkomerero. Si kintu ekyongeddwako oluvannyuma; kitundu ku njigiriza yennyini.

Ekibira kya payini e Old Orchard

Simpson yali amaze ebbanga eddene ery’obulamu bwe obw’obukulu ng’omulwadde ow’olubeerera. Yalina obulwadde bw’omutima, yali agudde emirundi egisukka mu gumu olw’okukola ennyo, era yatambulanga n’eccupa y’eddagala olw’obulumi obwamukwatanga buli lwe yalinnyanga amadaala. Omusawo omu mu New York yali amugambye nti yali asigazza emyezi nga esatu. Mu kyeya kya 1881, bwe yali awummulira mu kifo ky’enkuŋŋaana e Old Orchard Beach mu Maine, yawulira Dr Charles Cullis ng’ayigiriza ku kuwonya okw’obwakatonda. Ensonga ze teziyamukwatako nnyo okusinga obujulirwa bw’abantu abaali bawonyezeddwa. Yagenda n’asoma Endagaano Empya ye yennyini ku nsonga eyo, n’akakasa. Ku Lwokutaano olweggulo mu Agusito yatambula yekka n’ayingira mu kibira kya payini, n’akola obweyamo obw’ebitundu bisatu: nti akkiriza enjigiriza ya Bayibuli nti Yesu awonya omubiri; nti afuna Kristo awo wennyini ng’obulamu bw’omubiri gwe olwa buli kye gwetaaga okutuusa omulimu gw’obulamu bwe lwe gunaggwa; era nti amaanyi g’aweereddwa agenda kugakozesa olw’ekitiibwa kya Katonda n’okuweereza abalala. Olunaku olwaddirira yalinnya olusozi olwa futi enkumi ssatu obugulumivu. Amangu ddala oluvannyuma yasabira muwala we Margaret, eyali mulwadde nnyo obulwadde bwa diphtheria — obulwadde obwali butta mutabani we omuto Melville emyaka kkumi emabega — n’awona. Ye yennyini yawangaala emyaka emirala amakumi asatu mu munaana, era n’akola ku mbiro ezaakooyanga abasajja abaali abato ennyo okumusinga.

Kye yayigiriza

Simpson yannyonnyola endowooza ye mu Enjiri y’Okuwonya (The Gospel of Healing) (1885), era omutima gwayo kirowoozo ekikwata ku kutangirira.

Mazima ddala yeetikka obuyinike bwaffe, n’atwala ennaku yaffe …Naye yafumitibwa olw’okusobya kwaffe. Yabetentebwa olw’obutali butuukirivu bwaffe. Yeetikka ekibonerezo ffe tusobole okubeera n’emirembe. Ebiwundu bye, bye bituwonya. ISAAYA 53:4–5

Matayo ajuliza ekitundu ekisooka eky’ekyawandiikibwa ekyo, n’akikwasa butereevu ku buweereza bwa Kristo obw’okuwonya (Matayo 8:16–17). Okuva ku kino Simpson yawoza nti Kristo yeetikka endwadde zaffe mu mazima nga bwe yeetikka ebibi byaffe, era nti noolwekyo okuwonya kw’omubiri kuli munda mu ebyo omusaalaba bye gwagaba, so si bweru waabyo. Yegenderezanga nnyo ku ekyo kye kitategeeza. Teyayigiriza nti omubiri gwamala okununulibwa — yakkirizanga ddala nti okununulibwa kw’omubiri okujjuvu kulindiridde okuzuukira. Kye yagamba kyali nti ekitundu ku bulamu bw’okuzuukira kiriwo kaakano, okukozesebwa olw’okukkiriza, ng’amaanyi g’omubiri ng’omulimu Mukama gw’awadde omuntu oyo tegunnaggwa. Ebigambo bye ye yennyini byali nti yafuna Kristo ng’obulamu bw’omubiri gwe okutuusa omulimu gwange gwonna ogw’obulamu lwe gunaggwa — obukwakkulizo obulekebwa kumpi buli kiseera abantu bwe bamujuliza. Era yakalambiranga nti enjigiriza eno ekuumibwe mu kigero kyayo. Omubuulizi w’enjiri ow’okuwonya John Alexander Dowie bwe yamuyita okwewaayo eri kampeyini y’okuwonya mu ggwanga lyonna, Simpson yaddamu nti yalina ennamuziga nnya ku ggaali lye, era nti teyandisobodde kulagajjalira ssatu okwemalira ku emu. Teyakkiriza n’akatono okuwonya kufuuka bwe bubaka bwonna.

Ekiri mu Bayibuli ddala wano

Ebintu ebiwerako Simpson bye yakkaatirizanga biri mu Byawandiikibwa mu lwatu, era ekkanisa ezaawakanya ebisukkiridde emirundi mingi zibifiiriddwa. Katonda awonya, era awonya ne leero. Tewali kintu mu Byawandiikibwa kiwummuza nkola eyo. Ekkanisa eragiddwa okusabira abalwadde, era naddala okubasiiga amafuta ng’eyita mu bakulembeze baayo. Yakobo 5 kiragiro ekikyali kiyimiridde, ebibiina by’abakkiriza bingi nnyo bye bibuusa amaaso obubuusa.

Era okusaba kwabwe nga kuweereddwayo n’okukkiriza, kugenda kumuwonya, kubanga Mukama awonya. YAKOBO 5:15

Omubiri mukulu eri Katonda. Ye yagutonda, Kristo yatwala omubiri, era gulizuukizibwa. Obulamu bw’omwoyo obutwala omubiri ng’ogutaliiko makulu busemberera nnyo obukaafiiri obw’edda okusinga Ebyawandiikibwa. Era okusaasira kwa Kristo eri abalwadde kye kimu ku bintu ebisinga okweyoleka mu Njiri. Emirundi mingi yasaasiranga nnyo nga tannawonya muntu yenna.

We kiteekwa okutereezebwa

Kaakano okutereeza okwetaagisa, era kuteekwa okwogerwa awatali kukukendeeza, kubanga abantu balumiziddwa nnyo wano. Ebyawandiikibwa tebisuubiza kuwonya mu buli mbeera. Endagaano Empya eyogera ku bakkiriza abeesigwa abataawona. Pawulo yaleka Tulofiimo nga mulwadde e Mireeto (2 Timoseewo 4:20). Epafuladito yalwala n’atuuka kumpi n’okufa (Abafiripi 2:27). Timoseewo yalina obulwadde bw’olubuto obwaddiŋŋananga, era okubuulirira kwa Pawulo tekwali kunenya ku kukkiriza wabula ddagala lya bulijjo (1 Timoseewo 5:23). Era Pawulo yennyini yasaba emirundi esatu eriggwa lye liggibweko, n’agaanibwa.

Buli mulundi ng’aŋŋamba nti, “Ekisa kyange kikumala, kubanga amaanyi gange gatuukirira mu bunafu.” 2 ABAKKOLINSO 12:9

Ekyo ye Katonda ng’agaana okuwonya omutume, n’ayita okugaana okwo ekisa. Enjigiriza yonna etasobola kugumira lunyiriri luno erina ekikyamu. Abalwadde tebasaana kunenyezebwa n’akatono. Enjigiriza egamba nti obulwadde obutaggwaawo bukakasa nti okukkiriza kubulamu kya bukambwe, era ye nsobi Katonda gye yanenya mu kitabo kya Yobu. Eyongera omusango ku kubonaabona, era egoba ababonaabona okuva mu kkanisa mu kiseera kyennyini we bagyetaagira. Bwe baba baakugamba nti obulwadde bwo musango gwo, ekyo tekyali kirowoozo kya Kristo gy’oli. Eddagala si butakkiriza. Lukka, eyatambulanga ne Pawulo, ayitibwa omusawo omwagalwa. Omusamaliya yayiwa amafuta ne wayini mu biwundu. Isaaya yalagira ekitole ky’ettiini kiteekebwe ku jjute lya Keezeekiya mu kiseera kye kimu Katonda mwe yamwongerera ku bulamu mu ngeri ey’ekyamagero. Ebyawandiikibwa tebitwala wonna bujjanjabi n’okwesiga Katonda ng’ebivuganya. Enkola ya Simpson ye yennyini yagenda wala okusinga wano. Oluvannyuma lwa 1881 yeesamba ddala eddagala n’obujjanjabi ku lulwe, n’ayigiriza abalala okukola bwe batyo, era abamu ku abo abaamugoberera baafa endwadde ezandisobodde okujjanjabwa. Wano we tuteekwa okugaana okumugoberera, mu kitiibwa. Tewali kintu mu ssuula eno kisaana kuleetera musomi yenna kugaana, kulwisa oba kulekera awo bujjanjabi. Saba, era genda eri omusawo wo. Era buli muntu afa. Simpson yanafuwa, okujjukira kwe ne kuggwaawo, n’afa ng’aweza emyaka nsanvu mu etaano. Ekyo si kulemererwa kwa njigiriza ye; y’embeera y’omuntu. Okuwonya okusembayo tekuli mu bulamu buno.

Naffe tusinda munda yaffe nga tulindirira okufuuka abaana, kwe kununulibwa kw’emibiri gyaffe. ABARUUMI 8:23

Bwe kikwatibwa n’okutereeza okwo, omusingi gusigalawo era gusaanidde okuzzibwawo. Saba n’obuvumu olw’abalwadde. Gondera Yakobo 5. Lindirira Katonda okukola, era ekinaavaamu kirekere Ye. Era bw’ataawonya, tomaliriza nti taddamu — Pawulo teyamaliriza bw’atyo.

Engeri y’okusabira abalwadde

Ekigambo eky’ebikolwa, kubanga enjigiriza eno eyinza okuleka abakkiriza nga tebamanyi kye banaayogera ddala ku mabbali g’ekitanda ky’omulwadde. Saba n’obuvumu. Saba mu lwatu okuwonya, nga tozinga buli sentensi okutuusa lw’efuuka etaliimu makulu. Mukama yayita abantu okusaba butereevu, era omulwadde atera okuyambibwa okuwulira omuntu ng’asaba Katonda ekyo kyennyini ky’ayagala.

Saba ng’ogonda. Ekyokulabirako kiri mu Gesusemane, Omwana wa Katonda gye yasabira ekikompe kimuggibweko, n’ayongerako akakwakkulizo.

Naye si nga Nze bwe njagala, wabula nga ggwe bw’oyagala. MATAYO 26:39

Akakwakkulizo ako si kukkiriza kunafu. Kwe kukkiriza kw’Oyo eyalina okukkiriza okusinga omuntu yenna, era kugwanidde mu kusaba kwaffe olw’ensonga y’emu gye kwagwanira mu kusaba kwe. Tosuubiza kintu. Tobuulira mulwadde nti Katonda ddala ajja kumuwonya mu bulamu buno. Tomanyi, era bw’onooba ng’osobye, ajja kwetikka obulwadde n’okugwa kw’ebyo bye yagambibwa. Sigalawo. Ekintu eky’omuwendo ennyo abasinga obungi ku ffe kye tuyinza okuwaayo si nkola ya kusaba eyategekebwa, wabula okunyiikira — okweyongera okukyalira omulwadde ng’obupya bw’ensonga buweddewo era ng’obulwadde tebukendedde. Mikwano gya Yobu baali basinga obulungi mu nnaku omusanvu ze baatuula ne batayogera kintu. Era saba ebisinga ku mubiri. Saba okugumiikiriza, emirembe, obutabaamu bukaawu, n’ab’omu maka g’omulwadde. Essaala zino bulijjo ziba ng’okwagala kwa Katonda bwe kuli, era bulijjo ziddibwamu.

Mumutwalirenga byonna bye mweraliikirira kubanga abalumirwa era afaayo ku buli ekibatuukako. 1 PEETERO 5:7
OKUFUMIITIRIZA N’OKUKOLA

1. Saba mu ngeri entongole era ng’olina essuubi olw’omuntu omulwadde wiiki eno, nga tomusuubiza kiriva mu kusaba ekyo Katonda ky’atasuubizza.

2. Ekkanisa yo bw’eba tekolangako Yakobo 5:14, buuza abakulembeze bo lwaki.

3. Bwe baba nga bakuleetedde okuwulira nti obulwadde bwo ye nsala y’omusango ku kukkiriza kwo, kigaane. Ekyo si kye Byawandiikibwa biyigiriza.

4. Mira eddagala lyo era tosubwa nsisinkano zo n’omusawo. Okwesiga Katonda n’obujjanjabi tebivuganya.

5. Fumiitiriza ku 2 Abakkolinso 12:9 okutuusa lw’onoosobola okukyogera ku kintu Katonda ky’atakuggyeeko.

ESSAALA
Mukama Yesu, wawonyanga abalwadde kubanga wabasaasiranga, era tokyukanga.
Njigiriza okusabira ababonaabona n’obuvumu, nga seefuula kumanya by’otaŋŋambye.
Gy’owonya, nkuwe ekitiibwa. Gy’otawonya, nkuwulire ng’oyogera nti ekisa kyo kimala, era nkikkirize.
Era nkuuma obutayongera ku mugugu gw’omuntu omulala n’akatono, nga ndaga nti obulwadde bwe musango gwe. Amiina.

fields.title: Kristo Kabaka Waffe Ajja
fields.body_html:
Yesu oyo abaggiddwako n’atwalibwa mu ggulu, agenda kukomawo mu ngeri y’emu nga bwe mumulabye ng’agenda mu ggulu. EBIKOLWA BY’ABATUME 1:11

Ennamuziga ey’okuna, eri Simpson, teyali kyongerwako kya kuteebereza, wabula yali yingini ya buli kintu eky’ebikolwa kye yakola. Yazimba essomero ery’okutendeka, n’atandikawo ekibiina ky’obuminsani, era ne yeekooya emirundi egiddiŋŋana, kubanga yali akkiriza nti Kabaka ajja era nti waliwo omulimu ogulina okusooka okuggwa.

Okukomawo kwe yennyini okulirabibwa

Endowooza ye yali nnyangu, era yagiwolereza ku ndowooza endala ezaali zimanyiddwa mu biseera bye. Okukomawo kwa Kristo kwa Muntu yennyini — Yesu oyo, so si nnono, wadde amaanyi agakwata ku bantu, wadde okulongooka mpolampola kw’embeera z’abantu. Kulirabibwa. Era kintu ekibaawo omulundi gumu, so si lugendo.

Laba, ajja n’ebire, na buli liiso lirimulaba. OKUBIKKULIRWA 1:7
Kubanga Mukama waffe yennyini alikka okuva mu ggulu n’eddoboozi ery’omwanguka …n’abo abaafiira mu Kristo be balisooka okuzuukira. 1 BASESSALONIIKA 4:16

Simpson yali akwata endowooza eyitibwa premillennial — nti Kristo akomawo ng’omulembe gw’obutuukirivu ogwasuubizibwa tegunnatandika, so si ku nkomerero y’ekiseera eky’okukulaakulana kw’Ekikristaayo mpolampola. Kino kyali kikulu gy’ali mu bikolwa. Endowooza endala ey’essuubi eyali eyagalibwa mu mulembe gwe yagambanga nti ensi yali yeeyongera okulongooka buli kiseera, era nti obwakabaka bwali bujja okuyita mu bugunjufu n’enkyukakyuka z’embeera z’abantu. Simpson yalowooza nti endowooza eyo yaggyamu obwetaavu bw’okwanguyiriza mu buminsani, era ekyasa eky’amakumi abiri tekyagisaasira. Abakristaayo bayawukana ku bitundu ebitonotono eby’ebiseera, era babadde bayawukana bwe batyo okuva mu byasa ebyasooka. Endagaano Empya ky’ekakasa awatali kubuusabuusa kwe kubaawo kwakyo kwennyini.

Lwaki liyitibwa essuubi ery’omukisa

Nga tulindirira olunaku lwe tusuubira, n’okulabika kw’ekitiibwa kya Katonda omukulu era Omulokozi waffe Yesu Kristo. TITO 2:13

Simpson yamalanga ebbanga ku kigambo ekinnyonnyola essuubi eryo — ery’omukisa. Okukomawo kwa Kristo, eri omukkiriza, okusinga byonna si kya ntiisa. Ke kaseera olugero lwonna kwe lubadde lutambulira: enkomerero y’okwawukana, okukakasibwa kw’omugaso gwa buli kye twagumiikiriza, n’okulaba Oyo gwe twagala nga tetumulabangako.

Newaakubadde nga Yesu oyo temumulabangako, kyokka mumwagala …mumukkiriza ne mujjula essanyu eritayogerekeka ne mumugulumiza. 1 PEETERO 1:8

Yetegereza engeri Endagaano Empya gy’ekozesaamu ddala enjigiriza eno. Ekozesebwa okubudaabuda abafiiriddwa, okunyweza abayigganyizibwa, okuzzaamu amaanyi abategana, n’okuzuukusa abalagajjavu. Kumpi tekozesebwa n’akatono kumatiza kwagala kumanya.

Essuubi kye lizaala

Ebiva mu lyo bisatu, buli kimu n’ekyawandiikibwa kyakyo. Obulongoofu. Okusuubira okumulaba kulina amaanyi agalongoosa, amateeka obwago ge gatalina.

Buli muntu alina essuubi eryo yeetukuza nga Katonda bw’ali omutukuvu. 1 YOKAANA 3:3

Okutunula. Si kubalirira — okutunula. Omukkiriza abeera ng’omuweereza mukama we ayinza okukomawo essaawa yonna, era eyo mbeera ya njawulo ku y’omuntu amaze okubalirira enteekateeka y’ebiseera.

Noolwekyo mubeere beetegefu, kubanga olunaku Mukama wammwe lw’aliddirako temulumanyi. MATAYO 24:42

Okwanguyiriza omulimu gw’obuminsani. Kano ke kakwate akaafuganga obulamu bwa Simpson, era kava mu bigambo bya Mukama yennyini.

Era Enjiri ey’obwakabaka eribuulirwa mu nsi yonna, nga bwe bujulirwa eri amawanga gonna n’oluvannyuma enkomerero n’eryoka etuuka. MATAYO 24:14

Simpson ekyo yakisoma ng’omulimu ogulina akakwate akategeerekeka n’okukomawo kwa Kristo, era kyamufuula atasobola kuleka bantu abatannatuukibwako Njiri. Buli kitongole kye yatandikawo kyazimbibwa okutuusa abakozi mu bifo erinnya lya Kristo gye litannaba kuyatulwa.

We yasobya

Obwesimbu bwetaagisa okugattako ekigambo. Simpson n’abangi ku banne ab’omu biseera bye baali basuubira nti Enjiri yandituuse ku buli ggwanga mu mulembe gwabwe gwennyini, era nti Mukama yandyoke akomewo. Okusuubira okwo tekwatuukirira, era okusuubira okufaananako bwe kutyo kulemereddwa mu buli kyasa okuva ku kyasooka. Okutwalira awamu yeewalanga okuteekawo ennaku, era yali yeefuga okusinga bangi abaali bamwetoolodde. Naye endowooza y’okujja okw’amangu mu biwandiiko bye oluusi ekyuka mpolampola n’efuuka okubalirira, era omusomi asaana akukwate mpola. Mukama yennyini yagaana okuwa amawulire ago.

Naye Yesu n’abaddamu nti, Okumanya entuuko oba ebiro si kyammwe, kitange kye yateekateeka mu buyinza bwe. Naye muliweebwa amaanyi …era munaabanga bajulirwa bange. EBIKOLWA BY’ABATUME 1:7–8

Weetegereze olunyiriri bwe lugenda mu maaso. Okugaana okubawa enteekateeka y’ebiseera kuddirirwa amangu ddala omulimu gwe baakwasibwa. Eyo ye nteeka entuufu ddala, era ekuuma buli kirungi mu kwanguyiriza kwa Simpson nga bw’eggyawo ekyali kikyamu mu kwo.

Ekibuuzo eky’ebikolwa si kya ddi lw’alijja. Kya kuba nti wandisanyuse okusangibwa ng’okola ky’okola kaakano, ng’ajja.

Enjigiriza y’abali mu nnaku

Kisaanidde okwetegereza embeera enjigiriza esinga obujjuvu mu Ndagaano Empya ku kukomawo kwa Kristo mw’esangibwa, kubanga si lukuŋŋaana lwa bunnabbi. Pawulo awandiikira ekkanisa empya eyaziika abamu ku bammemba baayo, era nga yeeraliikirira ku bo. Ekibuuzo si kya ntegeka ya biseera. Kya kuba nti abafu baabwe balina kye basubiddwa.

Kaakano, abooluganda tetwagala mmwe obutategeera eby’abo abafu, ne munakuwala ng’abalala abatalina ssuubi. 1 BASESSALONIIKA 4:13

Awo Pawulo n’awa ekitundu ekikulu ekyogera ku Mukama ng’akka n’eddoboozi ery’omwanguka, abaafiira mu Kristo nga be basooka okuzuukira, n’abalamu nga basitulibwa wamu nabo. Era aggalawo si na kubakubiriza kutunuulira bubonero, wabula n’ekiragiro ekikwata ku kulabirira abantu mu ngeri ey’obusumba.

Kale buli omu agumyenga munne n’ebigambo ebyo. 1 BASESSALONIIKA 4:18

Simpson yakuuma enkozesa eno ey’enjigiriza eno nga yeeyoleka, era kye kigezo ekirungi eky’okumanya obanga tugikwata nga Ebyawandiikibwa bwe bigikwata. Omukkiriza ng’okwagala kwe ku kujja kwa Kristo omulundi ogwokubiri kwonna kwesibye ku bipande n’amawulire g’ebiriwo kaakano, aseerebye okuva ku kyokulabirako ky’abatume. Omukkiriza asobola okutuula n’omukwano gwe ali mu nnaku n’afuula okukomawo kwa Kristo okubudaabudibwa okw’amazima, aba agikozesa ddala nga Pawulo bwe yagikozesa. Weetegereze n’ebigambo wamu nabo. Okuddamu okusisinkana kitundu ku ssuubi. Okusuubira kw’Omukristaayo si kwokka nti aliraba Kristo, wabula nti okwawukana okufa kwe kwaleeta kwa kaseera buseera.

OKUFUMIITIRIZA N’OKUKOLA

1. Weebuuze obanga okukomawo kwa Kristo mu bulamu bwo kuli ng’enjigiriza gy’okkiriza obukkiriza, oba ng’essuubi ly’olindirira ddala.

2. Kozesa 1 Yokaana 3:3 mu ngeri ey’ebikolwa: londa ekintu kimu kye wandyagadde kikolebweko nga tannalabika, era kikoleko.

3. Lekera awo okubalirira, otandike okutunula. Bw’oba ogoberera okuteebereza ku bunnabbi, lowooza ekitundu ky’ekiseera ekyo ekyenkana wa ekyandigenze mu kwegayiririra abalala.

4. Kozesa essuubi lino nga Endagaano Empya bw’erikozesa — okubudaabuda omuntu afiiriddwa, oba okunyweza omuntu ali mu kanyigo.

5. Lowooza ku by’okola ebirigasa ku lunaku olwo, era obikole nnyo okusingawo.

ESSAALA
Mukama Yesu, ojja, naye obulamu bwange mbutegese ng’olinga atalijja.
Nsonyiwa otulo otutwala okukomawo kwo ng’enjigiriza so si ng’essuubi. Mfuula atunula, nga tonfudde ateebereza.
Nnongoosa. Ekirowoozo eky’okukulaba kikole mu nze ekyo amateeka kye gatakolangako.
Era nsangibwe nga nkola — mu bantu be wafiirira, mu bifo erinnya lyo gye litannayatulwa — bw’olijja. Amiina.

fields.title: Obulamu bwa Nze n’Obulamu bwa Kristo
fields.body_html:
Nakomererwa wamu ne Kristo; kyokka ndi mulamu, si ku bwange, wabula ku bwa Kristo abeera mu nze. ABAGGALATIYA 2:20

Ekimu ku bitabo bya Simpson ebisinga okukebera omutima kiyitibwa The Self Life and the Christ Life, era ensonga yaakyo eri nti ekizibu ky’Omukristaayo eky’omusingi si bibi bye wabula nze we yennyini.

Ekikolo wansi w’amatabi

Abasinga obungi ku ffe tukwata obulamu bwaffe obw’Ekikristaayo ku mutendera gw’ensobi ssekinnoomu. Tulaba obusungu obw’amangu, olulimi olusala, omuze gw’okugaziya ebigambo, ne tukola ku buli emu nga bw’erabise — nga tusalira amatabi, limu ku limu, okumala emyaka n’emyaka. Simpson ky’akakasa kiri nti amatabi geeyongera okukula kubanga ekikolo tekikwatiddwako. Wansi w’ebibi ssekinnoomu waliwo omusingi gumu ogubiruŋŋamya byonna: nze ng’ali wakati, ng’ategeka buli kintu okwetooloola obweyagaze bwe, erinnya lye n’okwagala kwe. Yali ayagala nnyo okubala engeri ez’enjawulo nze z’alabikamu, era olukalala olwo luswaza okulusoma kubanga lukwata kumpi buli muntu mu kifo ekimu. Okwagala kwa nze, okulina okufuna ekkubo lyakwo. Okweyagala, okutayinza kulagajjalirwa nga tekulumiddwa. Okwekakasa, okutandika omulimu gwa Katonda mu maanyi gaakwo. Okwetunuulira, okusannyalazibwa abalala kye balowooza. Okwesaasira, okuliisa ebikuluma byakwo. Okwenoonyeza, okwewolereza, okwesanyusa, okwekwasa. Era ekisinga okwekweka mu byonna, okwetwala ng’omutuukirivu — nze ng’eyeewuunya enkulaakulana ye yennyini mu kwekomerera.

Era bonna n’abagamba nti, Omuntu yenna ayagala okungoberera asaana yeefiirize yekka yeetikke omusaalaba gwe buli lunaku, angoberere! LUKKA 9:23

Simpson yalaga nti Mukama tagamba nti weefiirize ebintu. Agamba nti weefiirize ggwe kennyini — gaana nze okuba omusingi ogufuga. Okwefiiriza ebintu kyangu bw’okigeraageranya, era kuyinza okukolebwa n’okwesiima kungi.

Si kunyigiriza, wabula kuwaanyisa

Wano Simpson w’ayawukanira ku nkola y’okwebonyaabonya obwebonyaabonya, era enjawulo eyo gwe mutima gw’enjigiriza ye. Toyinza kuggyawo nze ng’omulumba. Buli kugezaako kuzaala engeri empya era ey’obukujjukujju obusingawo ey’ekintu kye kimu, kubanga oyo alumba ye nze. Omuntu ayinza okulumya omubiri gwe enjala, n’alekayo ebigendererwa bye eby’okwekuza, n’azimba erinnya ery’obwetoowaze, ate ku nkomerero ne yeemalira ku ye yennyini okusinga bwe yali ku ntandikwa. Eddagala si kuggyako wabula kuwaanyisa. Obulamu bwa nze bugobebwa obulamu bwa Kristo, ng’ekizikiza bwe kigobebwa ekitangaala, so si kuggibwawo lwa kufuba.

Kimugwanira ye okugulumizibwa naye nze okutoowazibwa. YOKAANA 3:30

Simpson yakakkatira ensengeka y’olunyiriri olwo. Okugulumizibwa kwe kusooka, ate okutoowazibwa ne kugoberera okuva mu ekyo. Tetwetoowaza tulyoke tusegulire Kristo ekifo; tufuna Kristo, era obukulu bwaffe ne bugwa mpola mu kasirise kubanga ekintu ekisinga obunene kituuse.

Omusaalaba ogwa buli lunaku

Weetegereze ebigambo buli lunaku mu Lukka 9:23. Simpson yabitwala nga bikulu, era bikuuma enjigiriza ye obutakozesebwa bubi nga bwe kibadde ku buli njigiriza ey’okwewaayo. Okwerowooza okw’Abaruumi 6 kukolebwa omulundi gumu. Okukussa mu nkola kuzzibwa buggya buli nkya, era emirundi egisinga mu mbeera ze tutaalonda. Omusaalaba tegututuukako ng’ekirowoozo ekitakwatikako wabula ng’okutaataaganyizibwa, okunyoomebwa akatono, ekitali kyangu, omuntu atakola kye twagala.

Kubanga ffe abalamu tuweebwayo eri okufa olwa Yesu, obulamu bwa Yesu bulyoke bulabisibwe mu mibiri gyaffe. 2 ABAKKOLINSO 4:11

Ekitundu eky’enkomerero kye kikulu. Okufa si kye kigendererwa ku bwakwo. Bulijjo kubaawo ekintu ekirala kiryoke kirabike.

Engeri y’omuntu si ye mulabe

Waliwo okulabula Simpson kwe yawa ye yennyini, era abagoberezi be oluusi kwe baabuza. Obulamu bwa nze si kye kimu n’engeri y’omuntu, embala ye, oba ebitone bye eby’obutonde. Ebyo Katonda ye yabikola era agenderera okubikozesa. Ekigendererwa si Mukristaayo atalina langi yonna — Simpson yennyini yasigala ng’amanyika bulungi ng’Omusukoti ow’e Canada eyavugibwanga amaanyi, alaba ewala era ategeka, okutuusa ku nkomerero y’ennaku ze, era ekibiina kye yazimba tekyandibaddewo singa teyali bw’atyo. Ekigenda ku musaalaba ye nze ng’ali wakati, so si nze ng’ekitonde. Peetero oluvannyuma lwa Pentekoote akyali Peetero omupapi; obupapi obwo kaakano buweereza Kristo mu kifo kya Peetero.

Nze mba mulamu lwa Kristo. ABAFIRIPI 1:21

Mu kino mulimu ekigezo ekitetaagisa kumanya by’eddiini kukikozesa.

Weetegereze ekibaawo mu ggwe omulundi oguddako lw’onoowakanyizibwa, lw’onoobuusibwa amaaso, oba lw’onoogololwa mu maaso g’abalala. Kyonna ekisituka mu kaseera ako, nga tekiyitiddwa, nga tonnafuna budde kutereeza ndabika ya maaso go — ekyo kye kintu essuula eno ky’eyogerako.

Nze mu mulimu gwa Mukama

Engeri ya nze esinga okwekweka, Simpson bwe yalaba, terabikira mu by’ensi n’akatono. Erabikira mu buweereza, gy’ekwekeddwa kumpi ddala kubanga buli kimu ku yo kifaanana ng’okwemalira ku Katonda. Nze ayinza okwegomba ekituuti n’akiyita omugugu ogw’emmeeme z’abantu. Ayinza okukwatirwa obuggya obuwanguzi bwa munne n’akiyita okufaayo ku njigiriza entuufu. Ayinza okukola okutuusa lw’akoowa ennyo n’akiyita okwewaayo eri Katonda, ng’ate ekimuvuga ddala bwe bwetaavu bw’okwetaagibwa. Ayinza okulwanirira ekifo kye n’obukakanyavu n’akiyita okulwanirira okukkiriza. Endagaano Empya emanyi ekizibu kino era eyogera amannya.

Nawandiikira Ekkanisa ku nsonga eyo, kyokka Diyotuleefe, olw’okwagala okwefuula omukulembeze tatwagala. 3 YOKAANA 1:9

Pawulo, eky’ewuunyisa, yasobola okwawula wakati w’obubaka n’ekigendererwa ky’abo abaabubuulira, n’okusanyuka ne bwe kyali nti ekigendererwa kyali kibi.

Weewaawo abamu bategeeza abantu Kristo lwa buggya na kuvuganya …Naye nze nfaayo ki? Kristo bw’abuulirwa, mu buli ngeri, oba za bukuusa oba za mazima, nze nsanyuka busanyusi. ABAFIRIPI 1:15, 18

Simpson yaggya mu kino ebintu bibiri. Ekisooka, nti Katonda asobola okukozesa obuweereza nze mw’alina ekitundu ekinene, ekyo kye kisaanidde okutuggyako okweraliikirira nti tewali kinaaweebwa mukisa okutuusa ng’ebigendererwa byaffe birongoofu — tebiribeera birongoofu ddala mu bujjuvu. Ekyokubiri, nti kino tekirina kufuuka kyekwaso eky’okuleka ebigendererwa byaffe nga tebyekebereddwa. Ekigezo eky’omu bikolwa kye yateesa kiswaza era kya mangu. Owulira otya omuntu omulala bw’akozesebwa okukola ekintu ggwe kye wali oyagala okukola? Eky’okuddamu kijja nga tonnakitereeza, era emirundi egisinga kiba kituufu.

OKUFUMIITIRIZA N’OKUKOLA

1. Yita mu lukalala lwa Simpson — okwagala kwa nze, okwesaasira, okwewolereza, okwenoonyeza — era otuume ekyo ekisinga okukutuukirako ddala.

2. Lekera awo okulumba nze butereevu. Amaanyi ago gemu gawe okufuna Kristo, olabe ekituuka ku kirala.

3. Okuwakanyizibwa oba okunyoomebwa okuddako kutwale ng’omusaalaba gw’olunaku olwo, so si ng’ekiziyiza obulamu bwo obw’omwoyo. Kye kikozesebwa kyennyini.

4. Bw’onootegeerwa bubi wiiki eno, gaana okwewolereza omulundi gumu, era weetegereze ekisituka.

5. Yawula nze ku ngeri y’omuntu. Tonoonya kukendeeza ku ggwe kennyini; noonya okukendeeza ku kwefuula amakkati go.

ESSAALA
Mukama Yesu, mmaze emyaka nga nsalira amatabi, era ekikolo tekikwatiddwako.
Kaakano nkiraba: si bibi byange byokka, wabula nze kennyini — nga ndi wakati, nga ntegeka buli kimu, nga njagala ekkubo lyange era nga nkiyita ekyo kye nzikiririzaamu.
Siyinza kwekomerera nzekka; buli kugezaako kunfudde ow’amalala olw’okugezaako okwo. Kale jjangu ogulumizibwe, era nze ntoowazibwe ng’ekivaamu so si ng’ekituukiddwako kyange.
Mpa omusaalaba gw’olwa leero, era ngutwale nga seemulugunya — obulamu bwa Yesu bulyoke bulabisibwe mu nze. Amiina.

fields.title: Okutukuzibwa Ddala
fields.body_html:
Katonda ow’emirembe abatukulize ddala, era omwoyo gwammwe gwonna, n’emmeeme yammwe n’omubiri gwammwe, bikuumibwenga nga tebiriiko kya kunenyezebwa okutuusa ku lunaku olw’okujja kwa Mukama waffe Yesu Kristo. 1 BASESSALONIIKA 5:23

Simpson yawandiika ebitabo bibiri ebitono ku nsonga y’essuula eno, era bigikwatako okuva ku njuyi ezikontana. Wholly Sanctified kinnyonnyola olunyiriri lumu, era kibuuza kitegeeza ki okuba owa Katonda mu bujjuvu. The Land of Promise kinnyonnyola maapu eyaggibwa mu kitabo kya Yoswa, era kibuuza lwaki bangi abalabikira ddala nga ba Katonda beefunidde bitono nnyo ku ebyo by’abawadde. Ekisooka y’enjigiriza; ekyokubiri kwe kuzuula obulwadde. Bwe bisomebwa wamu bikola ensonga emu, era etandikira ku kigambo kye yagaana okuleka. Pawulo tasaba Abasessaloniika batukuzibwe kitundu, oba batukuzibwe mu kitundu kyabwe eky’eddiini kyokka. Asabira omuntu yenna mulamba, n’alyoka atuuma ebitundu bye sikulwa nga waliwo atategeera bulungi: omwoyo, n’emmeeme, n’omubiri.

Ekigambo kino kye kitegeeza

Simpson yatandikira Endagaano Enkadde we etandikira, kubanga ebigambo bino gye biva. Okutukuza kwe kwawula. Ebintu by’omu Weema ya Mukama bwe byatukuzibwanga tebyalongoosebwanga mu mpisa — ebbakuli terina mpisa. Byaggibwanga mu kukozesebwa okwa bulijjo ne biweebwa Katonda okubikozesa. Ekyo kye kirowoozo eky’omusingi, era y’ensonga lwaki okutukuzibwa okusingira ddala si kwa kuggyawo nsobi.

Noolwekyo buli eyeewala ebintu ebyo ebitali bya kitiibwa anaabanga ow’ekitiibwa, atukuziddwa, asaanira okukozesebwa mukama we, olw’omulimu omulungi. 2 TIMOSEEWO 2:21

Mu kino mulimu entambula bbiri, era Simpson yakakkatira zombi. Waliwo okweyawula ku — okuggya ekibya mu kuweereza okwa bulijjo. Era waliwo okwewaayo eri — okukiwonga eri nannyini kyo, kaakano agenda okukikozesa nga bw’ayagala. Enjigiriza nnyingi ku butukuvu zikoma ku kisooka, ne zizaala Abakristaayo eddiini yaabwe gye kusinga kuba lukalala lwa bintu bye batakola. Okweyawula awatali kwewaayo kuzaala kibya kyereere, ekirongooseddwa n’obwegendereza naye nga tekikozesebwa ku kintu kyonna. Ensonga y’okuggya ebbakuli mu bintu ebya bulijjo kwe kugiteeka ku kyoto.

Omwoyo, emmeeme n’omubiri

Okutuuma ebitundu ebisatu kwa Pawulo kwawa Simpson ensengeka ye, era yakukozesa mu ngeri ey’omu bikolwa. Omwoyo gutukuzibwa ng’obulamu bw’omuntu obw’omunda ennyo bukyusiddwa okwolekera Katonda — ng’okussa kwe ekimu ne Katonda, omuntu we ow’omunda, n’okutegeera kwe okw’okwagala kwa Katonda bifugibwa Omwoyo Omutukuvu so si by’ayagala ye yennyini. Emmeeme etukuzibwa ng’ebirowoozo, enneewulira n’okwesalirawo bijja wansi wa Kristo. Simpson yassaayo nnyo omwoyo ku kitundu kino eky’omu makkati, kubanga eyo Abakristaayo abasinga gye babeera era eyo ebizibu ebisinga gye biri. Enneewulira ezitukuziddwa si nneewulira ezinyigiriziddwa; kwe kwagala okwegatta ku ebyo ebikugwanira. Okwesalirawo okutukuziddwa si kwesalirawo okumenyeddwa wabula okwewaddeyo.

So temwefaananyirizanga ba mirembe gino, naye mukyusibwe olw’okudda obuggya mu birowoozo byammwe. ABARUUMI 12:2

Omubiri gutukuzibwa ng’ebitundu byagwo biteekeddwa mu buyinza bwa Katonda — amaaso, olulimi, okwegomba emmere, emikono, essaawa. Simpson kino yakitwala nga bwe kiri ddala era awatali kukirungiya na nneewulira, era kye kifo enjigiriza ye ku butukuvu w’esisinkana butereevu enjigiriza ye ku kuwonya: omubiri si kibya ekyennyamiza ekisitula emmeeme wabula yeekaalu eyagulibwa na muwendo.

Oba temumanyi ng’omubiri gwammwe ye Yeekaalu ya Mwoyo Mutukuvu Katonda gwe yabawa, era n’emibiri gyammwe si gyammwe ku bwammwe? Kubanga mwagulibwa na muwendo, noolwekyo emibiri gyammwe gigulumizenga Katonda. 1 ABAKKOLINSO 6:19–20

Oyo Akikola

Kaakano sentensi Simpson gye yatwala ng’obukuumi bwonna obw’enjigiriza eno, era emirundi kumpi gyonna eggibwako olunyiriri bwe lujuliziddwa.

Oyo eyabayita mwesigwa era alikituukiriza. 1 BASESSALONIIKA 5:24

Pawulo tagamba Basessaloniika nti beetukulize ddala bokka. Asaba Katonda akikole, n’alyoka ayongerako nti Katonda mwesigwa era alikikola. Kino kye kikuuma enjigiriza ku butukuvu obutakwatibwa ndwadde zaayo ebbiri. Kiziyiza okuggwamu essuubi, kubanga ebinaavaamu tebyesigamye ku busobozi bw’omukkiriza. Era kiziyiza amalala, kubanga omulimu Katonda gw’akola tegulekera muntu yenna kye yeenyumiririzaamu. Waayo ekibya; Katonda ajja kukijjuza akikozese. Omugabo gwaffe kwe kukiwaayo; omugabo gwe bye byonna ebigoberera. Era mu kigambo bikuumibwenga mulimu okusaasira. Oyo ayawula ekibya era y’akikuuma, okutuusa ku kujja kwa Kristo — okweyama okuwanvu okusinga kwonna ffe kwe twandyeyamye ku lwaffe, nga kuweebwa Oyo atakoowa.

Ebifo bisatu

Obanga Katonda yasuubiza okukikola, lwaki abakkiriza bangi nnyo babeera ng’abalowooza nti teyasuubiza? Wano ekitabo ekyokubiri we kiyingirira. Ebyafaayo bya Isirayiri byawulwamu bitundu bisatu: Misiri, eddungu, ne Kanani. Simpson yali akkiriza — ng’agoberera engeri y’okusoma erina ennono empanvu mu njigiriza y’Abapulitaani n’eya Keswick — nti bino bikwatagana n’embeera ssatu abantu mwe bayinza okusangibwa.

Misiri buddu. Omuntu ali e Misiri tannanunulibwa, era muddu ka abe ng’akimanyi oba takimanyi. Eddungu y’embeera Simpson gye yali asinga okweraliikirira. Wano waliwo abantu abavudde ddala e Misiri — omusaayi gusiigiddwa, ennyanja esomokeddwa, ba Katonda — naye nga beetooloolera mu nkulungo. Balokole naye bawanguddwa. Balabye ddala Katonda bw’abagabirira naye tebeefuniddeko kintu kyonna. Babeera ku Maanu, beemulugunya nnyo, era bajjukira Misiri n’okwegomba okubatiisa bo bennyini. Kanani y’ensi ey’ekisuubizo: si bwangu bwa bulamu, wabula okwefunira ddala.

Simpson yaddiŋŋananga ensonga emu, kubanga ensobi eno ebunye nnyo. Kanani si ggulu. Tuyimba ku kusomoka Yoludaani ng’akabonero k’okufa, era kizaala ennyimba ennungi, naye tekiyinza kuyimirira bwe kyekebejjebwa. E Kanani mulimu ab’ekiwago, ebibuga ebiriko bbugwe, okuwangulwa ng’okw’e Ayi, n’emyaka egy’entalo. Tewali alwana ntalo mu ggulu. Kanani kye kifaananyi ky’obulamu bw’Ekikristaayo nga Katonda bw’abugenderera kaakano.

Nga bwe nasuubiza Musa, buli we munaalinnyanga ekigere, mbawaddewo. YOSWA 1:3

Weetegereze ekiseera ky’ekikolwa. Mbawaddewo. Ensi yaabwe dda lwa kuweebwa; bayingira mu ekyo ekyabwe dda.

Lwaki omulembe gumu tegwayingira

Omulembe ogw’omu ddungu gwayimirira ku nsalo e Kadesubanea ne gutayingira. Simpson yalwawo ku nsonga eyo, kubanga Ebyawandiikibwa bigyogera mu lwatu era si ye eyo gye twandirowoozezza. Tebaalemwa lwa bunafu, oba kubanga ab’ekiwago baali banene nnyo ddala. Baalemwa lwa butakkiriza. Abakessi kkumi ku kkumi na babiri baawa alipoota entuufu ku b’ekiwago, naye etali ntuufu ku Katonda.

Bwe batyo ne babunya mu baana ba Isirayiri alipoota etaali nnungi ng’efa ku nsi gye baali bagenze okuketta; …Bwe twetunulako nga tuli ng’obwacaaka, era nabo nga bwe batulaba bwe batyo. OKUBALA 13:32–33
Era tulaba nga baalemwa okuyingira olw’obutakkiriza bwabwe. ABAEBBULANIYA 3:19

Omuwandiisi w’Ebbaluwa eri Abaebbulaniya kino akikwasa butereevu ku Bakristaayo, era ekyo kye kiwa olukusa okugeraageranya kwonna. Takola kufaananya kwa kwefumiitiriza kwokka; awoza nti akabi ke kamu kayimiridde ku Kkanisa.

Naye Katonda atusuubizza olunaku olwa Ssabbiiti lwe tuliwummula, newaakubadde nga terunnatuuka …Noolwekyo tufubenga okuyingira mu kiwummulo ekyo, omuntu yenna alemenga kugoberera ekyokulabirako ekibi eky’abajeemu. ABAEBBULANIYA 4:9, 11

Wakati w’eddungu n’ensi waliwo omugga. Ennyanja Emyufu kwe kununulibwa okuva e Misiri — omusaalaba nga gukoleddwa ku musango gwaffe. Yoludaani, mu ngeri Simpson gye yagusomamu, gutegeeza okwegatta kw’omukkiriza ne Kristo mu kufa ne mu kuzuukira: enkomerero y’obulamu obukadde obwefuga bwokka, n’entandikwa y’obulamu obubeerawo okuva mu nsibuko endala. Ku lubalama olulala Maanu yakoma ne balya emmere ey’omu nsi, ekyo kye yatwala ng’ekifaananyi ky’enkyukakyuka okuva ku buyambi obw’akaseera ak’obwetaavu obwa buli lunaku okudda ku kwefunira okunywevu.

Bwe mutyo nammwe mwerowoozenga okuba abaafiira ddala eri ekibi, naye abalamu eri Katonda mu Kristo Yesu. ABARUUMI 6:11

Ekifo we tusaanidde okukwata kino nga tetunyweza nnyo

Obwesimbu bwetaagisa ebigambo bibiri wano. Ekisooka, engeri eno ey’okusoma eyinza okusindikibwa ewala ennyo. Ebyafaayo by’Endagaano Enkadde tebyawandiikibwa ng’olugero olw’akabonero olw’ebyo omuntu ssekinnoomu by’ayitamu mu mwoyo, era abannyonnyozi abatwala buli kantu ng’akabonero ak’ekyama emirundi mingi bakomye nga boogera kyonna kye baagala. Engeri ey’obwegendereza kwe kugoberera engeri Endagaano Empya yennyini gy’ekozesaamu ebyafaayo bino: Abaebbulaniya 3 ne 4 ziwa olukusa okugeraageranya, era ne 1 Abakkolinso 10 kye kimu bwe kikola. Ebiri ewala ku ebyo Ebyawandiikibwa byennyini bye biggyayo, bikwate nga tobinyweza.

Ekyokubiri, Simpson yayigiriza nti okutukuzibwa ddala mu bujjuvu emirundi egisinga kuyingirwamu mu kaseera ak’enkyukakyuka akategeerekeka ak’okwewaayo n’okukkiriza oluvannyuma lw’okukyuka — okusomoka Yoludaani. Abakristaayo bangi abatya Katonda bakkiriza kino; abalala bangi, nga basoma ebitundu bye bimu, balaba okutukuzibwa ng’okukulaakulana okutakoma okw’okwegatta ne Kristo okwaweebwa ku kukyuka, era bawakanya nti enteekateeka eno ekola ebibinja bibiri eby’abakkiriza mu ngeri Endagaano Empya gy’etakola. Okuwakanya okwo kulina amaanyi, era kusaanidde okupimibwa. Ekisigalawo oluvannyuma lw’okwerinda kwonna kye kiri mu nsonga yennyini: kisoboka ddala okuba ng’onunuliddwa ddala ate n’omala emyaka amakumi ng’oli kumpi tolina kye weefunidde ku ebyo Katonda by’akuwadde, era ensonga si bunafu wabula butakkiriza. Ensalo tesomokebwa lwa kufuba nnyo mu ddungu. Isirayiri teyayingira Kanani lwa kulongoosa nneeyisa yaayo mu ddungu. Yayingira lwa kuyingira.

Okuwummula n’olutalo wamu

Okutegeera obubi okusinga okubuna okw’enjigiriza eno kwe kulowooza nti ensi ey’ekisuubizo kitegeeza enkomerero y’okulwana. Ekitabo kya Yoswa kifuula ekyo ekitasoboka. Okuwangula ensi kwatwala emyaka, era ebitundu ebimu tebyawangulwa n’akatono, kubanga ebika ebimu tebyamaliriza. Obulamu Simpson bwe yali annyonnyola bwe bulamu okuwummula n’olutalo mwe bibeerera wamu — okuwummula ng’embeera y’omutima ennywevu, olutalo ng’ekitera okutuuka mu lunaku.

Katonda yatuzuukiriza wamu ne Kristo okuva mu kufa ne tufuna obulamu, era atutuuzizza mu bifo eby’omu ggulu, okumpi ne Kristo Yesu. ABAEFESO 2:6
Kubanga tetumeggana na mubiri wadde musaayi, wabula tulwanyisa abafuzi, n’ab’obuyinza. ABAEFESO 6:12

Batuuziddwa, era bameggana — mu bbaluwa y’emu, eri abantu be bamu. Era wano ebitabo byombi we bisisinkana. Ekigambo ddala mu kusaba kwa Pawulo kibikkula enteekateeka abasinga obungi ku ffe gye tugoberera mu bulamu bwaffe obwa buli lunaku. Waliwo ekitundu ky’obulamu kye twawaayo — emirundi egisinga ekitundu eky’eddiini olwatu — era waliwo ebitundu ebitayogerwangako mu kusaba n’akatono: engeri ssente gye zisaasaanyizibwamu, engeri gy’oyogeramu ne munno mu bufumbo, by’olaba ng’oli wekka, by’okola n’obusungu. Abakkiriza abasinga basobola okutuuma ebyabwe mu sikonda ntono nga babuuziddwa, ekiraga nti babadde babimanyi okumala ekiseera. Ekitabo kya Balamuzi kitandika n’olukalala lw’ebifo abantu baamu bye bataagobebwamu, era ekitabo ekisigadde kye kivaamu. Okuwangula okutaggwa tekusigala nga tekuliiko ludda; ekisigalawo kifuuka eriggwa mu mbiriizi. Ekitundu ky’osazeewo obutakiwakaanira tekijja kusigala ng’ekyawufu ekisirise.

Okukuuma okwewaayo

Okwewaayo okukolebwa omulundi gumu tekusigala nga bwe kwakolebwa awatali kufaayo, era Simpson yali alaba bulungi engeri gye kutonnya mpola mpola. Ssaddaaka eteekebwa ku kyoto mu kikolwa ekitegeerekeka — naye ebigambo bya Pawulo bye ssaddaaka ennamu, era ssaddaaka ennamu esobola okukka okuva ku kyoto.
