Ekintu ekyo ekisembayo tekisaanye kukwekebwa, kubanga kikulu mu busumba. Obanga omusajja eyayigiriza obulamu obw’omunda ennyo okumala emyaka amakumi ana yasobola okumaliriza mu kizikiza, olwo ekizikiza si bukakafu nti omuntu alemereddwa. Kiyinza okuba enkomerero obukomerero ey’embiro empanvu ezaddukibwa omubiri ogukaddiwa. Katonda teyamwagala katono mu 1919 okusinga mu 1881. Na kimu ku bino tekyogeddwa kumukendeeza. Kyogeddwa kubanga enjigiriza ye yennyini ey’eby’eddiini ekyetaaga. Enjigiriza ensonga yaayo yonna ey’okuba nti tetulina kintu mu ffe ffekka era tulina buli kintu mu Kristo, teyinza kusiimibwa nga twefuula nti omuyigiriza waayo yali wa njawulo.

Naye kaakano tulina ekyobugagga kino mu bibya eby’ebbumba, okulaga nti obuyinza bwonna bwa Katonda, so si bwaffe. 2 ABAKKOLINSO 4:7

Yafiira e Nyack mu kiseera eky’okugwa kw’ebikoola mu 1919, ng’amaze emyaka amakumi ana ng’agamba abantu nti Kabaka ajja mangu. Kabaka teyajja ng’akyali mulamu. Teyalekawo ssente. Yalekawo essomero ly’okutendeka erikoppeddwa ku buli lukalu lwa nsi, ekitabo ky’ennyimba, magazini, ekifo ky’okusinza ekijjudde ekika ky’abantu amakanisa amalala be gaali tegaagala, n’abakozi ebikumi ebiwerako mu nsi ze yasabiranga ng’azoogera amannya kyokka nga tazikyalirangako. Ekibiina ekyakulira mu ebyo kaakano kinene nnyo mu nsi ezo okusinga mu ye, era kirimu okusinga ennyo abantu abatamuwulirangako. Ekyo kyennyini kye yasaba. Teyakiraba. Kyabaawo bwe kityo, era eyo ye nteekateeka eya bulijjo, era ekyo tekyandimunyiizizza n’akatono — kasita ekitiibwa kyandigenze eri oyo gwe kisaanira.

ESSAALA
Mukama Yesu, nsomye ku kumala kwo okw’okumala byonna, era nsobola okufuula n’ekyo okumanya okw’omwoyo okulala okumu kwe nnaagoberera.
Kimpewe. Saagala mukisa; njagala ggwe. Saagala kuwulira kujjuvu okusingawo; njagala ekitundu kya nze ekisingawo kibe kikyo.
Beera obulokozi bwange, obutukuvu bwange, amaanyi gange, n’essuubi lyange. Kwatira wamu ennamuziga ennya ez’obulamu bwange, nneme kufuuka muntu wa ssira limu atalina kigero.
Era amaanyi gange bwe ganaggwaawo ku nkomerero, nga bwe gaamuggwaako, onkwate ne mu kiseera ekyo. Amiina.

fields.title: Obulagirizi bw’Omusomi ku A. B. Simpson
fields.body_html:
Fubanga okweraga ng’osiimibwa Katonda, ng’oli mukozi akola ebitakuswaza, era nga weekuumira mu kkubo ery’obubaka obw’amazima. 2 TIMOSEEWO 2:15

Simpson mwangu okusoma era mwangu okufuna. Yawandiikiranga ebibiina by’abantu aba bulijjo so si bayivu, sentensi ze mpimpi, era ebyokulabirako bye byangu okutegeera. Byonna bye yafulumya kaakano tebikyaliko bwannannyini, era bingi ku byo bifunibwa ku yintaneeti awatali kusasula. Obuzibu buli walala. Simpson yawandiika bingi nnyo, mangu, emirundi mingi ng’alina okumaliriza buli wiiki, era omutindo tegwenkana. Ebitabo ebimu biddiŋŋana. Obulagirizi obuli wansi butegekeddwa okuwonya omusomi okwonoona ebiseera.

Tandikira wano

Enjiri ey’Ebitundu Ebina (The Fourfold Gospel). Kimpi, era ky’ekisinga okuba omulyango omulungi okuyingiriramu. Ensengeka yonna mu mpapula ntono. The Self Life and the Christ Life. Ekitabo kye eky’omugaso ekisinga okukebera omutima, era gwe musingi gw’essuula Obulamu bwa Nze n’Obulamu bwa Kristo mu kitabo kino. Omusomi bw’aba ayagala okunyigirizibwa mu ngeri ey’omugaso, kino kye kitabo. Ennaku ez’Eggulu ku Nsi (Days of Heaven Upon Earth). Ekitabo eky’okusoma buli lunaku, ekikyakubibwa oluvannyuma lw’ekyasa ekisukka. Ye ntandikwa esinga obukkakkamu ey’okumumanya, era kirabo kirungi.

Ku bulamu obw’omunda ennyo

Wholly Sanctified. Akatabo akatono ku 1 Basessaloniika 5:23. Kategeerekeka, kalimu ebbugumu era ka mugaso. The Land of Promise. Ennyonnyola ye ey’ebifaananyi bya Kanani, ekyogerwako wamu nakyo mu ssuula Okutukuzibwa Ddala. A Larger Christian Life. Ku kugaziwa mu kukkiriza, mu buweereza ne mu kusuubira. The Christ Life. Ebiwandiiko ebimpi ku kwegatta ne Kristo.

Ku Mwoyo Omutukuvu

The Holy Spirit, or Power from on High, mu bitabo bibiri, ebigoberera omulimu gw’Omwoyo mu Ndagaano Enkadde ne mu Ndagaano Empya buli kimu ku bwakyo. Kiwanvu, naye ky’ekisinga okunnyonnyola mu bujjuvu enjigiriza eri mu ssuula Okubeera Munda n’Okujjula. When the Comforter Came. Ebisomwa ebimpi amakumi asatu mu kimu; kyangu nnyo okusoma.

Ku kusaba ne ku Byawandiikibwa

The Life of Prayer. Kimpi era kya mugaso. Christ in the Bible. Ennyonnyola ye ku Byawandiikibwa byonna, ekitabo ku kitabo, mu bitabo bingi, ng’abuuza ku buli kimu Kristo w’asangibwa. Tekisaanye kusomebwa okuva ku ntandikwa okutuuka ku nkomerero; kya kwebuuzaako wamu na kyonna ky’oyiga. The Names of Jesus. Okuyiga ku mannya g’ekitiibwa ga Kristo.

Soma n’obwegendereza

Enjiri y’Okuwonya (The Gospel of Healing, 1885). Ky’ekisinga okunnyonnyola mu bujjuvu enjigiriza eyogerwako mu ssuula Kristo Omuwonya Waffe, era kye kitabo ekyetaaga okulabula okuteekeddwa eyo. Simpson yennyini okuleka eddagala n’obujjanjabi kwasukka ku ebyo Ebyawandiikibwa bye biyigiriza, era abasomi tebasaanidde kumugoberera mu ekyo. Kisome wamu ne 2 Abakkolinso 12:7–10 ne 2 Timoseewo 4:20.

Ennyimba

Simpson yawandiika ennyimba ezisoba mu kikumi, emirundi mingi okuyimbibwa ekibiina kye yennyini mu nnaku ntono nga zimaze okuwandiikibwa. Ye Yennyini (Himself) lwe luyimba olukulu ennyo era lwogera eby’eddiini bye byonna; Jesus Only ne Yesterday, Today, Forever nazo zimanyiddwa nnyo. Kirungi okuzisoma ng’enjigiriza enfunze, so si ng’ebitontome eby’okusinza byokka.

Ebimwogerako

Wingspread (1943) ekya A. W. Tozer bye byafaayo bye ebisinga okumanyibwa, ebyawandiikibwa omwana wa Alliance asinga okututumuka. Kimpi, kimusiima, kiwandiikiddwa bulungi nnyo, era si byafaayo ebimwekenneenya. The Life of A. B. Simpson (1920) ekya A. E. Thompson bye byafaayo ebitongole, ebyafulumizibwa omwaka oguddirira okufa kwe, era bya muwendo olw’okuba nti byawandiikibwa ng’ebintu ebyo byakabaawo. A. B. Simpson and the Pentecostal Movement ekya Charles Nienkirchen kye kitabo eky’abayivu ekimanyiddwa ennyo ku mpaka z’okwogera mu nnimi ezoogerwako mu ssuula Okubeera Munda n’Okujjula, era kimwekenneenya okusinga ebyafaayo eby’okuzimba omwoyo. Soma ebisukka mu kimu. Ebyafaayo ebikadde byawandiikibwa abantu abaamwagala, era kirabikira ku ebyo bye baleka ebbali.

Okubuulirira kusatu ku kumusoma

Musome nga Bayibuli ebikkudde. Simpson teyeegamba buyinza bwonna obubwe ku bubwe, era enkola ye yali ya kuwakana ng’asinziira ku byawandiikibwa. Bikebere. Musome olw’omugugu gw’alina ku mutima so si olw’ensengeka ye. W’asindika ensengeka okusukka Ebyawandiikibwa bye byogera — mu njigiriza y’okuwonya, mu kaseera ak’enkyukakyuka ak’okutukuzibwa, ne mu kusuubira nti omulimu gw’obuminsani gwandiwedde mangu — twala okufaayo kwe okw’obusumba, oleke emiti egy’okuzimbirako.

Era musome mpola. Ebitabo bye bimpi era bisobola okumalirizibwa mu kawungeezi kamu, era ekyo kyennyini kye kireeta akabi. Essuula emu buli wiiki, ng’ekoleddwako, ejja kukola bingi okusinga ebitabo bye byonna nga bisiimibwa busiimibwa.

Mwekenneenyenga ebintu byonna, kale bwe bibanga ebirungi mubinywezenga. 1 BASESSALONIIKA 5:21
